   156	def build_filter_graph(
   157	    inputs: RenderCommandInputs,
   158	) -> tuple[list[str], int | None]:
   159	    """Return the legacy filter graph and optional stream-copy input index."""
   160	
   161	    timeline_data = inputs.timeline_data
   162	    registry = inputs.registry
   163	    width, height, fps = timeline_canvas(timeline_data)
   164	    tracks = {
   165	        track.get("id"): track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])
   166	    }
   167	    visual_track_ids = {
   168	        track["id"]
   169	        for track in tracks.values()
   170	        if track.get("kind") == "visual"
   171	    }
   172	    audio_track_ids = {
   173	        track["id"]
   174	        for track in tracks.values()
   175	        if track.get("kind") == "audio"
   176	    }
   177	    video_clips = sorted(
   178	        [
   179	            clip
   180	            for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   181	            if clip.get("track") in visual_track_ids
   182	        ],
   183	        key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
   184	    )
   185	    audio_clips = sorted(
   186	        [
   187	            clip
   188	            for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   189	            if clip.get("track") in audio_track_ids
   190	        ],
   191	        key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
   192	    )
   193	    if not video_clips:
   194	        raise ValueError("ffmpeg engine needs at least one visual media clip")
   195	
   196	    asset_keys: list[str] = []
   197	    for clip in [*video_clips, *audio_clips]:
   198	        asset_key = str(clip.get("asset") or "")
   199	        if not asset_key:
   200	            raise ValueError(f"Clip {clip.get('id')!r} has no asset")
   201	        if asset_key not in registry["assets"]:
   202	            raise ValueError(
   203	                f"Clip {clip.get('id')!r} references unknown asset "
   204	                f"{asset_key!r}"
   205	            )
   206	        if asset_key not in asset_keys:
   207	            asset_keys.append(asset_key)
   208	
   209	    asset_index = {
   210	        asset_key: index for index, asset_key in enumerate(asset_keys)
   211	    }
   212	    filters: list[str] = []
   213	    video_labels: list[str] = []
   214	    copy_video_input: int | None = None
   215	    if len(video_clips) == 1:
   216	        clip = video_clips[0]
   217	        asset_key = str(clip["asset"])
   218	        entry = registry["assets"][asset_key]
   219	        source_duration = entry.get("duration")
   220	        source_resolution = entry.get("resolution")
   221	        source_fps = entry.get("fps")
   222	        start = float(clip.get("from", 0) or 0)
   223	        end = float(clip.get("to", start) or start)
   224	        at = float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0)
   225	        full_duration = (
   226	            isinstance(source_duration, (int, float))
   227	            and abs((end - start) - float(source_duration)) < 0.05
   228	        )
   229	        same_resolution = source_resolution == f"{width}x{height}"
   230	        same_fps = (
   231	            isinstance(source_fps, (int, float))
   232	            and not isinstance(source_fps, bool)
   233	            and math.isfinite(float(source_fps))
   234	            and abs(float(source_fps) - fps) < 1e-6
   235	        )
   236	        no_visual_adjustments = not any(
   237	            key in clip
   238	            for key in (
   239	                "x",
   240	                "y",
   241	                "width",
   242	                "height",
   243	                "cropTop",
   244	                "cropBottom",
   245	                "cropLeft",
   246	                "cropRight",
   247	                "effects",
   248	                "transition",
   249	            )
   250	        )
   251	        if (
   252	            at == 0
   253	            and start == 0
   254	            and full_duration
   255	            and same_resolution
   256	            and same_fps
   257	            and no_visual_adjustments
   258	        ):
   259	            copy_video_input = asset_index[asset_key]
   260	    if copy_video_input is None:
   261	        for index, clip in enumerate(video_clips):
   262	            inp = asset_index[str(clip["asset"])]
   263	            start = float(clip.get("from", 0) or 0)
   264	            end = float(clip.get("to", start) or start)
   265	            label = f"v{index}"
   266	            filters.append(
   267	                f"[{inp}:v]trim=start={start:.6f}:end={end:.6f},"
   268	                "setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,"
   269	                f"scale={width}:{height}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
   270	                f"pad={width}:{height}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,"
   271	                f"fps={fps},format=yuv420p[{label}]"
   272	            )
   273	            video_labels.append(f"[{label}]")
   274	        filters.append(
   275	            "".join(video_labels)
   276	            + f"concat=n={len(video_labels)}:v=1:a=0[vout]"
   277	        )
   278	
   279	    audio_labels: list[str] = []
   280	    cursor = 0.0
   281	    audio_index = 0
   282	    for clip in audio_clips:
   283	        at = float(clip.get("at", 0))
   284	        if at > cursor + 1e-9:
   285	            duration = at - cursor
   286	            label = f"a{audio_index}"
   287	            filters.append(
   288	                "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo,"
   289	                f"atrim=duration={duration:.6f}[{label}]"
   290	            )
   291	            audio_labels.append(f"[{label}]")
   292	            audio_index += 1
   293	        inp = asset_index[str(clip["asset"])]
   294	        start = float(clip.get("from", 0))
   295	        end = float(clip.get("to"))
   296	        track = tracks[str(clip["track"])]
   297	        from astrid.packs.rendering.backends.ffmpeg.support import effective_gain
   298	
   299	        volume = effective_gain(track, clip)
   300	        label = f"a{audio_index}"
   301	        filters.append(
   302	            f"[{inp}:a]atrim=start={start:.6f}:end={end:.6f},"
   303	            "asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,"
   304	            "aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo,"
   305	            f"volume={volume:.6f}[{label}]"
   306	        )
   307	        audio_labels.append(f"[{label}]")
   308	        cursor = at + clip_duration_seconds(clip)
   309	        audio_index += 1
   310	
   311	    if audio_clips:
   312	        visual_duration = max(
   313	            float(clip.get("at", 0)) + clip_duration_seconds(clip)
   314	            for clip in video_clips
   315	        )
   316	        if visual_duration > cursor + 1e-9:
   317	            duration = visual_duration - cursor
   318	            label = f"a{audio_index}"
   319	            filters.append(
   320	                "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo,"
   321	                f"atrim=duration={duration:.6f}[{label}]"
   322	            )
   323	            audio_labels.append(f"[{label}]")
   324	        filters.append(
   325	            "".join(audio_labels)
   326	            + f"concat=n={len(audio_labels)}:v=0:a=1[aout]"
   327	        )
   328	    return filters, copy_video_input
   329	
   330	
   331	def _has_audio_clips(timeline_data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
   332	    tracks = {
   333	        track.get("id"): track
   334	        for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])
   335	        if isinstance(track, Mapping)
   336	    }
   337	    return any(
   338	        isinstance(clip, Mapping)
   339	        and clip.get("clipType") == "media"
   340	        and tracks.get(clip.get("track"), {}).get("kind") == "audio"
   341	        for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   342	    )
   343	
   344	
   345	def _asset_input_argv(inputs: RenderCommandInputs) -> list[str]:
   346	    timeline_data = inputs.timeline_data
   347	    registry = inputs.registry
   348	    tracks = {
   349	        track.get("id"): track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])
   350	    }
   351	    visual_track_ids = {
   352	        track["id"]
   353	        for track in tracks.values()
   354	        if track.get("kind") == "visual"
   355	    }
   356	    audio_track_ids = {
   357	        track["id"]
   358	        for track in tracks.values()
   359	        if track.get("kind") == "audio"
   360	    }
   361	    video_clips = sorted(
   362	        [
   363	            clip
   364	            for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   365	            if clip.get("track") in visual_track_ids
   366	        ],
   367	        key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
   368	    )
   369	    audio_clips = sorted(
   370	        [
   371	            clip
   372	            for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   373	            if clip.get("track") in audio_track_ids
   374	        ],
   375	        key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
   376	    )
   377	    asset_keys: list[str] = []
   378	    for clip in [*video_clips, *audio_clips]:
   379	        asset_key = str(clip.get("asset") or "")
   380	        if asset_key and asset_key not in asset_keys:
   381	            asset_keys.append(asset_key)
   382	
   383	    argv: list[str] = []
   384	    for asset_key in asset_keys:
   385	        entry = registry["assets"][asset_key]
   386	        file_value = entry.get("file")
   387	        if not isinstance(file_value, str) or not file_value:
   388	            raise ValueError(
   389	                "ffmpeg engine requires local file assets; "
   390	                f"{asset_key!r} has no file"
   391	            )
   392	        asset_path = Path(file_value)
   393	        if not asset_path.is_absolute():
   394	            asset_path = (inputs.assets_path.parent / asset_path).resolve()
   395	        argv.extend(["-i", str(asset_path)])
   396	    return argv
   397	
   398	
   399	def build_render_command_from_inputs(inputs: RenderCommandInputs) -> list[str]:
   400	    """Return FFmpeg argv for already-resolved, strictly supported inputs."""
   401	
   402	    filters, copy_video_input = build_filter_graph(inputs)
   403	    has_audio = _has_audio_clips(inputs.timeline_data)
   404	    return [
   405	        "ffmpeg",
   406	        "-hide_banner",
   407	        "-y",
   408	        *_asset_input_argv(inputs),
   409	        *(["-filter_complex", ";".join(filters)] if filters else []),
   410	        "-map",
   411	        (
   412	            f"{copy_video_input}:v:0"
   413	            if copy_video_input is not None
   414	            else "[vout]"
   415	        ),
   416	        *(["-map", "[aout]"] if has_audio else []),
   417	        "-c:v",
   418	        "copy" if copy_video_input is not None else "libx264",
   419	        *(
   420	            ["-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20"]
   421	            if copy_video_input is None
   422	            else []
   423	        ),
   424	        *(
   425	            ["-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k"]
   426	            if has_audio
   427	            else ["-an"]
   428	        ),
   429	        "-movflags",
   430	        "+faststart",
   431	        str(inputs.output_path),
   432	    ]
   433	
   434	
   435	def build_render_command(
   436	    request: RenderRequest | Mapping[str, Any],
   437	    workspace: Path,
   438	) -> list[str]:
   439	    """Build FFmpeg argv for ``workspace/outputs/<request.output_name>``."""
   440	
   441	    return build_render_command_from_inputs(
   442	        resolve_render_command_inputs(request, workspace)
   443	    )
   444	
   445	
   446	def build_render_command_for_paths(
   447	    timeline_path: Path,
   448	    assets_path: Path,
   449	    output_path: Path,
   450	) -> list[str]:
   451	    """Compatibility builder for the legacy facade's explicit output path."""
   452	
   453	    return build_render_command_from_inputs(
   454	        _command_inputs_for_paths(timeline_path, assets_path, output_path)
   455	    )

    73	def _render_ffmpeg_media_to_path(
    74	    timeline_path: Path,
    75	    assets_path: Path,
    76	    out_path: Path,
    77	    *,
    78	    runner: Any | None = None,
    79	) -> Path:
    80	    """Execute the pure media command builder for one explicit output path."""
    81	
    82	    output = Path(out_path)
    83	    command_argv = build_render_command_for_paths(
    84	        Path(timeline_path),
    85	        Path(assets_path),
    86	        output,
    87	    )
    88	    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    89	    (subprocess.run if runner is None else runner)(command_argv, check=True)
    90	    return output

    93	def render(
    94	    timeline_path: Path,
    95	    assets_path: Path,
    96	    out_path: Path,
    97	    *,
    98	    previous_outputs: Sequence[Path] = (),
    99	    _render_to_path: Any | None = None,
   100	) -> Path:
   101	    """Render privately and publish the legacy video-plus-sidecar pair."""
   102	
   103	    resolved_out = Path(out_path).resolve()
   104	    resolved_out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   105	    with TemporaryDirectory(
   106	        prefix=f".{resolved_out.name}.publication-",
   107	        dir=str(resolved_out.parent),
   108	    ) as publication_tmp:
   109	        staged_video = Path(publication_tmp) / resolved_out.name
   110	        render_to_path = _render_ffmpeg_media_to_path
   111	        if _render_to_path is not None:
   112	            render_to_path = _render_to_path
   113	        render_to_path(timeline_path, assets_path, staged_video)
   114	        provenance = remotion_backend._render_provenance_payload(

   120	            composition_id="TimelineComposition",
   121	            theme_path=None,
   122	            active_theme=None,
   123	            registry_state=remotion_backend._effective_registry_state(None),
   124	            stage_summary={"root": None, "effects": []},
   125	        )
   126	        output = publish_render_result(
   127	            staged_video,
   128	            provenance,
   129	            out_path=out_path,
   130	            sidecar_path=remotion_backend._render_provenance_sidecar_path(
   131	                out_path
   132	            ),
   133	            previous_outputs=previous_outputs,
   134	        )
   135	
   136	    audit = AuditContext.from_env()
   137	    if audit is not None:
   138	        timeline_id = audit.register_asset(
   139	            kind="timeline",
   140	            path=timeline_path,
   141	            label="Render timeline",
   142	            stage="render_ffmpeg",
   143	        )
   144	        assets_id = audit.register_asset(

   147	            label="Render asset registry",
   148	            stage="render_ffmpeg",
   149	        )
   150	        render_id = audit.register_asset(
   151	            kind="render",
   152	            path=output,
   153	            label="Rendered video",
   154	            parents=[timeline_id, assets_id],
   155	            stage="render_ffmpeg",
   156	            metadata={"engine": "ffmpeg"},
   157	        )
   158	        audit.register_node(
   159	            stage="render_ffmpeg",
   160	            label="Render media-only timeline with ffmpeg",
   161	            parents=[timeline_id, assets_id],
   162	            outputs=[render_id],
   163	            metadata={"engine": "ffmpeg"},
   164	        )
   165	    return output

   170	
   171	def _legacy_media_acceptance(
   172	    timeline_path: Path,
   173	    assets_path: Path,
   174	) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
   175	    try:
   176	        timeline_data = json.loads(
   177	            Path(timeline_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
   178	        )
   179	        if not isinstance(timeline_data, dict):
   180	            raise ValueError("timeline must contain a JSON object")
   181	        timeline.load_registry(Path(assets_path))
   182	        validate_ffmpeg_media_timeline(timeline_data)
   183	        tracks = {
   184	            track.get("id"): track
   185	            for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])
   186	        }
   187	        has_visual_media_clip = any(
   188	            clip.get("clipType") == "media"
   189	            and tracks.get(clip.get("track"), {}).get("kind") == "visual"
   190	            for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   191	        )
   192	        if not has_visual_media_clip:
   193	            return False, "ffmpeg engine needs at least one visual media clip"
   194	    except Exception as exc:
   195	        return False, str(exc) or type(exc).__name__
   196	    return True, None
   197

   199	def can_render_with_ffmpeg_media(
   200	    timeline_path: Path,
   201	    assets_path: Path,
   202	) -> bool:
   203	    """Return the facade's legacy FFmpeg-media eligibility decision."""
   204	
   205	    accepted, _reason = _legacy_media_acceptance(timeline_path, assets_path)
   206	    return accepted

   212	def support(request: RenderRequest, *, workspace: Path) -> SupportReport:
   213	    """Load request files and delegate to the fail-closed evaluator."""
   214	
   215	    timeline_path = _input_path(request.timeline_path, workspace)
   216	    if request.assets_registry_path is None:
   217	        return _support_load_failure("rendering.ffmpeg requires an assets registry")
   218	    assets_path = _input_path(request.assets_registry_path, workspace)
   219	    try:
   220	        timeline_data = json.loads(timeline_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   221	        if not isinstance(timeline_data, dict):
   222	            raise ValueError("timeline must contain a JSON object")
   223	        assets = timeline.load_registry(assets_path)
   224	    except Exception as exc:
   225	        return _support_load_failure(str(exc) or type(exc).__name__)
   226	
   227	    localized = replace(
   228	        request,
   229	        timeline_path=str(timeline_path),
   230	        assets_registry_path=str(assets_path),
   231	    )
   232	    return strict_support(
   233	        localized,
   234	        timeline_data,
   235	        assets,
   236	        probe=ffprobe_metadata_strict,
   237	    )

   240	def _support_load_failure(reason: str) -> SupportReport:
   241	    return SupportReport(
   242	        schema_version=SCHEMA_VERSION,
   243	        supported=False,
   244	        reasons=[reason],
   245	        features={
   246	            "media_only": False,
   247	            "full_timeline": True,
   248	            "windows": False,
   249	            "sequential_audio": True,
   250	            "audio_reactive_colour": False,
   251	            "whole_media": False,
   252	            "whole_media_optimization": False,
   253	            "stream_copy": False,
   254	            "audio_ownership": AudioOwnership.NONE.value,
   255	        },
   256	        alternatives=list(ALTERNATIVE_BACKENDS),
   257	        backend=BACKEND_ID,
   258	        backend_version=BACKEND_VERSION,
   259	    )

   262	def _audio_reactive_ffmpeg_element(
   263	    theme_path: Path | None,
   264	) -> Any | None:
   265	    effects, _aliases = remotion_backend._effect_registry_for_assets(theme_path)
   266	    element = effects.get(audio_reactive_colour.EFFECT_ID)
   267	    if (
   268	        element is None
   269	        or element.metadata.get("ffmpegAdapter")
   270	        != audio_reactive_colour.ADAPTER_ID
   271	    ):
   272	        return None
   273	    return element

   276	def render_audio_reactive_colour_if_supported(
   277	    timeline_path: Path,
   278	    assets_path: Path,
   279	    out_path: Path,
   280	    *,
   281	    project_dir: Path | None,
   282	    composition_id: str,
   283	    theme_path: Path | None,
   284	    previous_outputs: Sequence[Path] = (),
   285	    element_resolver: Any | None = None,
   286	) -> Path | None:
   287	    """Preserve the facade's early audio-reactive FFmpeg specialization."""
   288	
   289	    timeline_data = json.loads(Path(timeline_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   290	    clips = timeline_data.get("clips")
   291	    if (
   292	        not isinstance(clips, list)
   293	        or len(clips) != 2
   294	        or sum(
   295	            isinstance(clip, dict)
   296	            and clip.get("clipType") == audio_reactive_colour.EFFECT_ID
   297	            for clip in clips
   298	        )
   299	        != 1
   300	    ):
   301	        return None
   302	    resolve_element = _audio_reactive_ffmpeg_element
   303	    if element_resolver is not None:
   304	        resolve_element = element_resolver
   305	    element = resolve_element(theme_path)
   306	    if element is None:
   307	        return None
   308	    registry = timeline.load_registry(Path(assets_path))
   309	    spec = audio_reactive_colour.match_and_validate(
   310	        timeline_data,
   311	        registry,
   312	        Path(assets_path),
   313	    )
   314	    if spec is None:
   315	        return None
   316	
   317	    resolved_out = Path(out_path).resolve()
   318	    resolved_out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   319	    stage_summary = {
   320	        "root": None,
   321	        "effects": [
   322	            {
   323	                "effect_id": element.id,
   324	                "source_pack_id": remotion_backend._source_pack_id(element),
   325	                "source": element.source,
   326	                "element_root": str(element.root),
   327	                "clip_ids": [
   328	                    str(clip.get("id"))
   329	                    for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   330	                    if isinstance(clip, dict)
   331	                    and clip.get("clipType") == element.id
   332	                ],
   333	                "staged_asset_ids": [],
   334	                "staged_assets": {},
   335	            }
   336	        ],
   337	    }
   338	    with TemporaryDirectory(
   339	        prefix=f".{resolved_out.name}.publication-",
   340	        dir=str(resolved_out.parent),
   341	    ) as publication_tmp:
   342	        staged_video = Path(publication_tmp) / resolved_out.name
   343	        rendered_video = audio_reactive_colour.render(spec, staged_video)
   344	        provenance = remotion_backend._render_provenance_payload(
   345	            out_path,
   346	            engine="ffmpeg",
   347	            timeline_path=timeline_path,
   348	            assets_path=assets_path,
   349	            project_dir=project_dir or (REPO_ROOT / "remotion"),
   350	            composition_id=composition_id,
   351	            theme_path=theme_path,
   352	            active_theme=None,
   353	            registry_state=remotion_backend._effective_registry_state(
   354	                theme_path
   355	            ),
   356	            stage_summary=stage_summary,
   357	        )
   358	        provenance["ffmpeg_specialization"] = audio_reactive_colour.ADAPTER_ID
   359	        provenance["audio_reactive_colour"] = {
   360	            "markers": [
   361	                {
   362	                    "frame": event.frame,
   363	                    "color": event.color,
   364	                    "id": event.event_id,
   365	                }
   366	                for event in spec.events
   367	            ],
   368	            "event_count": len(spec.events),
   369	            "fps": spec.fps,
   370	            "frame_count": spec.total_frames,
   371	            "marker_sha256": spec.marker_sha256,
   372	        }
   373	        output = publish_render_result(
   374	            rendered_video,
   375	            provenance,
   376	            out_path=out_path,
   377	            sidecar_path=remotion_backend._render_provenance_sidecar_path(
   378	                out_path
   379	            ),
   380	            previous_outputs=previous_outputs,
   381	        )
   382	
   383	    audit = AuditContext.from_env()
   384	    if audit is not None:
   385	        timeline_id = audit.register_asset(
   386	            kind="timeline",
   387	            path=timeline_path,
   388	            label="Audio-reactive render timeline",
   389	            stage="render_ffmpeg_audio_reactive_colour",
   390	        )
   391	        assets_id = audit.register_asset(
   392	            kind="assets_registry",
   393	            path=assets_path,
   394	            label="Audio-reactive asset registry",
   395	            stage="render_ffmpeg_audio_reactive_colour",
   396	        )
   397	        render_id = audit.register_asset(
   398	            kind="render",
   399	            path=output,
   400	            label="Rendered audio-reactive colour video",
   401	            parents=[timeline_id, assets_id],
   402	            stage="render_ffmpeg_audio_reactive_colour",
   403	            metadata={
   404	                "engine": "ffmpeg",
   405	                "specialization": audio_reactive_colour.ADAPTER_ID,
   406	                "event_count": len(spec.events),
   407	                "marker_sha256": spec.marker_sha256,
   408	            },
   409	        )
   410	        audit.register_node(
   411	            stage="render_ffmpeg_audio_reactive_colour",
   412	            label="Render audio-reactive colour timeline with FFmpeg",
   413	            parents=[timeline_id, assets_id],
   414	            outputs=[render_id],
   415	            metadata={
   416	                "engine": "ffmpeg",
   417	                "specialization": audio_reactive_colour.ADAPTER_ID,
   418	            },
   419	        )
   420	    return output

   422	
   423	def _required(value: Any, label: str) -> Any:
   424	    if value is None:
   425	        raise RuntimeError(f"ffprobe did not report {label}")
   426	    return value
   427	
   428	
   429	def _profile_from_probe(
   430	    probe: MediaProbe,
   431	    ownership: AudioOwnership,
   432	) -> RenderProfile:
   433	    if not probe.has_video_stream:
   434	        raise RuntimeError("ffprobe did not report a video stream")
   435	    if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED and not probe.has_audio_stream:
   436	        raise RuntimeError(
   437	            "rendering.ffmpeg media output did not contain its rendered audio"
   438	        )
   439	    if ownership is not AudioOwnership.RENDERED and probe.has_audio_stream:
   440	        raise RuntimeError(
   441	            "rendering.ffmpeg visual-only output unexpectedly contained audio"
   442	        )
   443	    audio_layout = probe.audio_channel_layout
   444	    if audio_layout is None and probe.audio_channels == 2:
   445	        audio_layout = "stereo"
   446	    elif audio_layout is None and probe.audio_channels == 1:
   447	        audio_layout = "mono"
   448	    return RenderProfile(
   449	        width=_required(probe.width, "video width"),
   450	        height=_required(probe.height, "video height"),
   451	        fps_rational=_required(probe.fps_rational, "video frame rate"),
   452	        time_base=_required(probe.time_base, "video time base"),
   453	        container=_required(probe.container, "container"),
   454	        video_codec=_required(probe.video_codec, "video codec"),
   455	        video_profile=probe.video_profile,
   456	        video_level=probe.video_level,
   457	        pixel_format=_required(probe.pixel_format, "pixel format"),
   458	        audio_codec=(
   459	            _required(probe.audio_codec, "audio codec")
   460	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   461	            else None
   462	        ),
   463	        audio_sample_rate=(
   464	            _required(probe.audio_sample_rate, "audio sample rate")
   465	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   466	            else None
   467	        ),
   468	        audio_channel_layout=(
   469	            _required(audio_layout, "audio channel layout")
   470	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   471	            else None
   472	        ),
   473	        duration_tolerance=1,
   474	    )
   475	
   476	
   477	def _duration_frames(probe: MediaProbe, profile: RenderProfile) -> int:
   478	    if probe.duration_rational is not None:
   479	        duration = Fraction(*probe.duration_rational)
   480	    elif probe.duration_seconds is not None:
   481	        duration = Fraction(str(probe.duration_seconds))
   482	    else:
   483	        raise RuntimeError("ffprobe did not report a video duration")
   484	    frames = duration * Fraction(*profile.fps_rational)
   485	    return max(1, int(frames + Fraction(1, 2)))
   486	
   487	
   488	def _protocol_render(
   489	    request: RenderRequest,
   490	    *,
   491	    workspace: Path,
   492	) -> RenderResult:
   493	    report = support(request, workspace=workspace)
   494	    if not report.supported:
   495	        raise_unsupported_error(
   496	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   497	            message="FFmpeg does not support this render request",
   498	            recovery_command="resolve the reported support reasons and retry",
   499	            details={"reasons": report.reasons, "features": report.features},
   500	        )
   501	
   502	    ownership = AudioOwnership(str(report.features["audio_ownership"]))
   503	    timeline_path = _input_path(request.timeline_path, workspace)
   504	    if request.assets_registry_path is None:
   505	        raise ValueError("rendering.ffmpeg requires an assets registry")
   506	    assets_path = _input_path(request.assets_registry_path, workspace)
   507	    specialization_spec: audio_reactive_colour.AudioReactiveColourSpec | None = None
   508	    if report.features.get("audio_reactive_colour") is True:
   509	        timeline_data = json.loads(timeline_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   510	        registry = timeline.load_registry(assets_path)
   511	        specialization_spec = audio_reactive_colour.match_and_validate(
   512	            timeline_data,
   513	            registry,
   514	            assets_path,
   515	        )
   516	        if specialization_spec is None:
   517	            raise RuntimeError(
   518	                "audio-reactive support evidence did not produce a specialization spec"
   519	            )
   520	
   521	    outputs_dir = workspace / "outputs"
   522	    output_path = outputs_dir / request.output_name
   523	    outputs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   524	    output_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   525	    try:
   526	        if specialization_spec is not None:
   527	            audio_reactive_colour.render(specialization_spec, output_path)
   528	        else:
   529	            subprocess.run(build_render_command(request, workspace), check=True)
   530	        try:
   531	            probe = ffprobe_metadata_strict(output_path)
   532	            probed_profile = _profile_from_probe(probe, ownership)
   533	        except (MediaProbeError, RuntimeError) as exc:
   534	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   535	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
   536	                message=f"FFmpeg output could not be validated: {exc}",
   537	                recovery_command=(
   538	                    "rerun rendering.ffmpeg in a fresh invocation workspace"
   539	                ),
   540	                details={"error_type": type(exc).__name__},
   541	            )
   542	        declared_profile = request.profile or probed_profile
   543	        duration_frames = _duration_frames(probe, declared_profile)
   544	        provenance_v1 = remotion_backend._render_provenance_payload(
   545	            output_path,
   546	            engine="ffmpeg",
   547	            timeline_path=timeline_path,
   548	            assets_path=assets_path,
   549	            project_dir=REPO_ROOT / "remotion",
   550	            composition_id="TimelineComposition",
   551	            theme_path=None,
   552	            active_theme=None,
   553	            registry_state=remotion_backend._effective_registry_state(None),
   554	            stage_summary={"root": None, "effects": []},
   555	        )
   556	        fragment: dict[str, Any] = {
   557	            "renderer": "ffmpeg",
   558	            "renderer_version": BACKEND_VERSION,
   559	            "support_evidence": report.features,
   560	            "legacy_v1": provenance_v1,
   561	        }
   562	        if specialization_spec is not None:
   563	            markers = [
   564	                {
   565	                    "frame": event.frame,
   566	                    "color": event.color,
   567	                    "id": event.event_id,
   568	                }
   569	                for event in specialization_spec.events
   570	            ]
   571	            specialization_fragment = {
   572	                "id": audio_reactive_colour.ADAPTER_ID,
   573	                "markers": markers,
   574	                "event_count": len(specialization_spec.events),
   575	                "frame_count": specialization_spec.total_frames,
   576	                "fps": specialization_spec.fps,
   577	                "marker_sha256": specialization_spec.marker_sha256,
   578	            }
   579	            fragment["specialization"] = specialization_fragment
   580	            provenance_v1["ffmpeg_specialization"] = (
   581	                audio_reactive_colour.ADAPTER_ID
   582	            )
   583	            provenance_v1["audio_reactive_colour"] = {
   584	                key: value
   585	                for key, value in specialization_fragment.items()
   586	                if key != "id"
   587	            }
   588	        video = VideoArtifact.from_file(
   589	            path=output_path,
   590	            workspace_root=workspace,
   591	            profile=declared_profile,
   592	            duration_frames=duration_frames,
   593	            audio=ownership,
   594	        )
   595	        result = RenderResult(
   596	            schema_version=SCHEMA_VERSION,
   597	            video=video,
   598	            audio_ownership=ownership,
   599	            backend_fragments={
   600	                BACKEND_ID: fragment
   601	            },
   602	            normalization=[],
   603	            logs=[],
   604	            metadata=request.metadata,
   605	        )
   606	        validate_render_result(
   607	            result,
   608	            expected_profile=declared_profile,
   609	            workspace_root=workspace,
   610	        )
   611	        return result
   612	    except BaseException:
   613	        output_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   614	        raise
   615	
   616	
   617	def _load_request(path: Path) -> RenderRequest:
   618	    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   619	    if not isinstance(payload, Mapping):
   620	        raise TypeError("render request must contain a JSON object")
   621	    return RenderRequest.from_dict(payload).for_backend(BACKEND_ID)
   622	
   623	
   624	def _write_failure(result_path: Path, exc: BaseException, *, kind: str) -> None:
   625	    if isinstance(exc, RendererException):
   626	        error_kind = exc.error.kind
   627	        message = exc.error.message
   628	        recovery = exc.error.recovery_command
   629	        details = exc.error.details
   630	    else:
   631	        error_kind = kind
   632	        message = str(exc) or type(exc).__name__
   633	        recovery = None
   634	        details = {"error_type": type(exc).__name__}
   635	    error = make_renderer_error(
   636	        error_kind,
   637	        backend=BACKEND_ID,
   638	        message=message,
   639	        recovery_command=recovery,
   640	        details=details,
   641	    )
   642	    write_json_atomic(result_path, error.to_dict())
   643	
   644	
   645	def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
   646	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   647	    parser.add_argument("verb", choices=("render", "support"))
   648	    parser.add_argument("--request", type=Path, required=True)
   649	    parser.add_argument("--result", type=Path, required=True)
   650	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
   651	
   652	    try:
   653	        request_path = args.request.resolve(strict=True)
   654	        result_path = args.result.resolve()
   655	        if request_path == result_path:
   656	            raise ValueError("--request and --result must be different paths")
   657	        request = _load_request(request_path)
   658	    except (
   659	        OSError,
   660	        ValueError,
   661	        TypeError,
   662	        json.JSONDecodeError,
   663	        RendererException,
   664	    ) as exc:
   665	        _write_failure(args.result.resolve(), exc, kind="protocol")
   666	        return 0
   667	
   668	    try:
   669	        workspace = request_path.parent
   670	        response: RenderResult | SupportReport
   671	        if args.verb == "support":
   672	            response = support(request, workspace=workspace)
   673	        else:
   674	            response = _protocol_render(request, workspace=workspace)
   675	        write_json_atomic(result_path, response.to_dict())
   676	    except RendererException as exc:
   677	        _write_failure(result_path, exc, kind=exc.error.kind)
   678	    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
   679	        _write_failure(result_path, exc, kind="binary_missing")

   133	    resolved_timeline = Path(timeline_path).resolve()
   134	    resolved_assets = Path(assets_path).resolve()
   135	    if not resolved_timeline.exists():
   136	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Timeline missing: {resolved_timeline}")
   137	    if not resolved_assets.exists():
   138	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Asset registry missing: {resolved_assets}")
   139	    timeline_data = json.loads(resolved_timeline.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   140	    if not isinstance(timeline_data, dict):
   141	        raise ValueError("timeline must contain a JSON object")
   142	    registry = timeline.load_registry(resolved_assets)
   143	    validate_ffmpeg_media_timeline(timeline_data)
   144	    return RenderCommandInputs(
   145	        timeline_path=resolved_timeline,
   146	        assets_path=resolved_assets,
   147	        # The legacy explicit-path helper passed the caller's spelling through
   148	        # to FFmpeg and returned the same Path.  Protocol requests use the
   149	        # workspace builder above, which deliberately resolves their output.
   150	        output_path=Path(output_path),
   151	        timeline_data=timeline_data,
   152	        registry=dict(registry),
   153	    )

   156	def build_filter_graph(
   157	    inputs: RenderCommandInputs,
   158	) -> tuple[list[str], int | None]:
   159	    """Return the legacy filter graph and optional stream-copy input index."""
   160	
   161	    timeline_data = inputs.timeline_data
   162	    registry = inputs.registry
   163	    width, height, fps = timeline_canvas(timeline_data)
   164	    tracks = {
   165	        track.get("id"): track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])
   166	    }
   167	    visual_track_ids = {
   168	        track["id"]
   169	        for track in tracks.values()
   170	        if track.get("kind") == "visual"
   171	    }
   172	    audio_track_ids = {
   173	        track["id"]
   174	        for track in tracks.values()
   175	        if track.get("kind") == "audio"
   176	    }
   177	    video_clips = sorted(
   178	        [
   179	            clip
   180	            for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   181	            if clip.get("track") in visual_track_ids
   182	        ],
   183	        key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
   184	    )
   185	    audio_clips = sorted(
   186	        [
   187	            clip
   188	            for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   189	            if clip.get("track") in audio_track_ids
   190	        ],
   191	        key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
   192	    )
   193	    if not video_clips:
   194	        raise ValueError("ffmpeg engine needs at least one visual media clip")
   195	
   196	    asset_keys: list[str] = []
   197	    for clip in [*video_clips, *audio_clips]:
   198	        asset_key = str(clip.get("asset") or "")
   199	        if not asset_key:
   200	            raise ValueError(f"Clip {clip.get('id')!r} has no asset")
   201	        if asset_key not in registry["assets"]:
   202	            raise ValueError(
   203	                f"Clip {clip.get('id')!r} references unknown asset "
   204	                f"{asset_key!r}"
   205	            )
   206	        if asset_key not in asset_keys:
   207	            asset_keys.append(asset_key)
   208	
   209	    asset_index = {
   210	        asset_key: index for index, asset_key in enumerate(asset_keys)
   211	    }
   212	    filters: list[str] = []
   213	    video_labels: list[str] = []
   214	    copy_video_input: int | None = None
   215	    if len(video_clips) == 1:
   216	        clip = video_clips[0]
   217	        asset_key = str(clip["asset"])
   218	        entry = registry["assets"][asset_key]
   219	        source_duration = entry.get("duration")
   220	        source_resolution = entry.get("resolution")
   221	        source_fps = entry.get("fps")
   222	        start = float(clip.get("from", 0) or 0)
   223	        end = float(clip.get("to", start) or start)
   224	        at = float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0)
   225	        full_duration = (
   226	            isinstance(source_duration, (int, float))
   227	            and abs((end - start) - float(source_duration)) < 0.05
   228	        )
   229	        same_resolution = source_resolution == f"{width}x{height}"
   230	        same_fps = (
   231	            isinstance(source_fps, (int, float))
   232	            and not isinstance(source_fps, bool)
   233	            and math.isfinite(float(source_fps))
   234	            and abs(float(source_fps) - fps) < 1e-6
   235	        )
   236	        no_visual_adjustments = not any(
   237	            key in clip
   238	            for key in (
   239	                "x",
   240	                "y",
   241	                "width",
   242	                "height",
   243	                "cropTop",
   244	                "cropBottom",
   245	                "cropLeft",
   246	                "cropRight",
   247	                "effects",
   248	                "transition",
   249	            )
   250	        )
   251	        if (
   252	            at == 0
   253	            and start == 0
   254	            and full_duration
   255	            and same_resolution
   256	            and same_fps
   257	            and no_visual_adjustments
   258	        ):
   259	            copy_video_input = asset_index[asset_key]
   260	    if copy_video_input is None:
   261	        for index, clip in enumerate(video_clips):
   262	            inp = asset_index[str(clip["asset"])]
   263	            start = float(clip.get("from", 0) or 0)
   264	            end = float(clip.get("to", start) or start)
   265	            label = f"v{index}"
   266	            filters.append(
   267	                f"[{inp}:v]trim=start={start:.6f}:end={end:.6f},"
   268	                "setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,"
   269	                f"scale={width}:{height}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
   270	                f"pad={width}:{height}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,"
   271	                f"fps={fps},format=yuv420p[{label}]"
   272	            )
   273	            video_labels.append(f"[{label}]")
   274	        filters.append(
   275	            "".join(video_labels)
   276	            + f"concat=n={len(video_labels)}:v=1:a=0[vout]"
   277	        )
   278	
   279	    audio_labels: list[str] = []
   280	    cursor = 0.0
   281	    audio_index = 0
   282	    for clip in audio_clips:
   283	        at = float(clip.get("at", 0))
   284	        if at > cursor + 1e-9:
   285	            duration = at - cursor
   286	            label = f"a{audio_index}"
   287	            filters.append(
   288	                "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo,"
   289	                f"atrim=duration={duration:.6f}[{label}]"
   290	            )
   291	            audio_labels.append(f"[{label}]")
   292	            audio_index += 1
   293	        inp = asset_index[str(clip["asset"])]
   294	        start = float(clip.get("from", 0))
   295	        end = float(clip.get("to"))
   296	        track = tracks[str(clip["track"])]
   297	        from astrid.packs.rendering.backends.ffmpeg.support import effective_gain
   298	
   299	        volume = effective_gain(track, clip)
   300	        label = f"a{audio_index}"
   301	        filters.append(
   302	            f"[{inp}:a]atrim=start={start:.6f}:end={end:.6f},"
   303	            "asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,"
   304	            "aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo,"
   305	            f"volume={volume:.6f}[{label}]"
   306	        )
   307	        audio_labels.append(f"[{label}]")
   308	        cursor = at + clip_duration_seconds(clip)
   309	        audio_index += 1
   310	
   311	    if audio_clips:
   312	        visual_duration = max(
   313	            float(clip.get("at", 0)) + clip_duration_seconds(clip)
   314	            for clip in video_clips
   315	        )
   316	        if visual_duration > cursor + 1e-9:
   317	            duration = visual_duration - cursor
   318	            label = f"a{audio_index}"
   319	            filters.append(
   320	                "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo,"
   321	                f"atrim=duration={duration:.6f}[{label}]"
   322	            )
   323	            audio_labels.append(f"[{label}]")
   324	        filters.append(
   325	            "".join(audio_labels)
   326	            + f"concat=n={len(audio_labels)}:v=0:a=1[aout]"
   327	        )
   328	    return filters, copy_video_input
   329

   331	def _has_audio_clips(timeline_data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
   332	    tracks = {
   333	        track.get("id"): track
   334	        for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])
   335	        if isinstance(track, Mapping)
   336	    }
   337	    return any(
   338	        isinstance(clip, Mapping)
   339	        and clip.get("clipType") == "media"
   340	        and tracks.get(clip.get("track"), {}).get("kind") == "audio"
   341	        for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   342	    )

   345	def _asset_input_argv(inputs: RenderCommandInputs) -> list[str]:
   346	    timeline_data = inputs.timeline_data
   347	    registry = inputs.registry
   348	    tracks = {
   349	        track.get("id"): track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])
   350	    }
   351	    visual_track_ids = {
   352	        track["id"]
   353	        for track in tracks.values()
   354	        if track.get("kind") == "visual"
   355	    }
   356	    audio_track_ids = {
   357	        track["id"]
   358	        for track in tracks.values()
   359	        if track.get("kind") == "audio"
   360	    }
   361	    video_clips = sorted(
   362	        [
   363	            clip
   364	            for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   365	            if clip.get("track") in visual_track_ids
   366	        ],
   367	        key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
   368	    )
   369	    audio_clips = sorted(
   370	        [
   371	            clip
   372	            for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   373	            if clip.get("track") in audio_track_ids
   374	        ],
   375	        key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
   376	    )
   377	    asset_keys: list[str] = []
   378	    for clip in [*video_clips, *audio_clips]:
   379	        asset_key = str(clip.get("asset") or "")
   380	        if asset_key and asset_key not in asset_keys:
   381	            asset_keys.append(asset_key)
   382	
   383	    argv: list[str] = []
   384	    for asset_key in asset_keys:
   385	        entry = registry["assets"][asset_key]
   386	        file_value = entry.get("file")
   387	        if not isinstance(file_value, str) or not file_value:
   388	            raise ValueError(
   389	                "ffmpeg engine requires local file assets; "
   390	                f"{asset_key!r} has no file"
   391	            )
   392	        asset_path = Path(file_value)
   393	        if not asset_path.is_absolute():
   394	            asset_path = (inputs.assets_path.parent / asset_path).resolve()
   395	        argv.extend(["-i", str(asset_path)])
   396	    return argv

   399	def build_render_command_from_inputs(inputs: RenderCommandInputs) -> list[str]:
   400	    """Return FFmpeg argv for already-resolved, strictly supported inputs."""
   401	
   402	    filters, copy_video_input = build_filter_graph(inputs)
   403	    has_audio = _has_audio_clips(inputs.timeline_data)
   404	    return [
   405	        "ffmpeg",
   406	        "-hide_banner",
   407	        "-y",
   408	        *_asset_input_argv(inputs),
   409	        *(["-filter_complex", ";".join(filters)] if filters else []),
   410	        "-map",
   411	        (
   412	            f"{copy_video_input}:v:0"
   413	            if copy_video_input is not None
   414	            else "[vout]"
   415	        ),
   416	        *(["-map", "[aout]"] if has_audio else []),
   417	        "-c:v",
   418	        "copy" if copy_video_input is not None else "libx264",
   419	        *(
   420	            ["-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20"]
   421	            if copy_video_input is None
   422	            else []
   423	        ),
   424	        *(
   425	            ["-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k"]
   426	            if has_audio
   427	            else ["-an"]
   428	        ),
   429	        "-movflags",
   430	        "+faststart",
   431	        str(inputs.output_path),
   432	    ]

    66	def _input_path(raw_path: str, workspace: Path) -> Path:
    67	    candidate = Path(raw_path).expanduser()
    68	    return (
    69	        candidate if candidate.is_absolute() else workspace / candidate
    70	    ).resolve()

    73	def _render_ffmpeg_media_to_path(
    74	    timeline_path: Path,
    75	    assets_path: Path,
    76	    out_path: Path,
    77	    *,
    78	    runner: Any | None = None,
    79	) -> Path:
    80	    """Execute the pure media command builder for one explicit output path."""
    81	
    82	    output = Path(out_path)
    83	    command_argv = build_render_command_for_paths(
    84	        Path(timeline_path),
    85	        Path(assets_path),
    86	        output,
    87	    )
    88	    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    89	    (subprocess.run if runner is None else runner)(command_argv, check=True)
    90	    return output

    93	def render(
    94	    timeline_path: Path,
    95	    assets_path: Path,
    96	    out_path: Path,
    97	    *,
    98	    previous_outputs: Sequence[Path] = (),
    99	    _render_to_path: Any | None = None,
   100	) -> Path:
   101	    """Render privately and publish the legacy video-plus-sidecar pair."""
   102	
   103	    resolved_out = Path(out_path).resolve()
   104	    resolved_out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   105	    with TemporaryDirectory(
   106	        prefix=f".{resolved_out.name}.publication-",
   107	        dir=str(resolved_out.parent),
   108	    ) as publication_tmp:
   109	        staged_video = Path(publication_tmp) / resolved_out.name
   110	        render_to_path = _render_ffmpeg_media_to_path
   111	        if _render_to_path is not None:
   112	            render_to_path = _render_to_path
   113	        render_to_path(timeline_path, assets_path, staged_video)
   114	        provenance = remotion_backend._render_provenance_payload(
   115	            out_path,
   116	            engine="ffmpeg",
   117	            timeline_path=timeline_path,
   118	            assets_path=assets_path,
   119	            project_dir=REPO_ROOT / "remotion",
   120	            composition_id="TimelineComposition",
   121	            theme_path=None,
   122	            active_theme=None,
   123	            registry_state=remotion_backend._effective_registry_state(None),
   124	            stage_summary={"root": None, "effects": []},
   125	        )
   126	        output = publish_render_result(
   127	            staged_video,
   128	            provenance,
   129	            out_path=out_path,
   130	            sidecar_path=remotion_backend._render_provenance_sidecar_path(
   131	                out_path
   132	            ),
   133	            previous_outputs=previous_outputs,
   134	        )
   135	
   136	    audit = AuditContext.from_env()
   137	    if audit is not None:
   138	        timeline_id = audit.register_asset(
   139	            kind="timeline",
   140	            path=timeline_path,
   141	            label="Render timeline",
   142	            stage="render_ffmpeg",
   143	        )
   144	        assets_id = audit.register_asset(
   145	            kind="assets_registry",
   146	            path=assets_path,
   147	            label="Render asset registry",
   148	            stage="render_ffmpeg",
   149	        )
   150	        render_id = audit.register_asset(
   151	            kind="render",
   152	            path=output,
   153	            label="Rendered video",
   154	            parents=[timeline_id, assets_id],
   155	            stage="render_ffmpeg",
   156	            metadata={"engine": "ffmpeg"},
   157	        )
   158	        audit.register_node(
   159	            stage="render_ffmpeg",
   160	            label="Render media-only timeline with ffmpeg",
   161	            parents=[timeline_id, assets_id],
   162	            outputs=[render_id],
   163	            metadata={"engine": "ffmpeg"},
   164	        )
   165	    return output

   171	def _legacy_media_acceptance(
   172	    timeline_path: Path,
   173	    assets_path: Path,
   174	) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
   175	    try:
   176	        timeline_data = json.loads(
   177	            Path(timeline_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
   178	        )
   179	        if not isinstance(timeline_data, dict):
   180	            raise ValueError("timeline must contain a JSON object")
   181	        timeline.load_registry(Path(assets_path))
   182	        validate_ffmpeg_media_timeline(timeline_data)
   183	        tracks = {
   184	            track.get("id"): track
   185	            for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])
   186	        }
   187	        has_visual_media_clip = any(
   188	            clip.get("clipType") == "media"
   189	            and tracks.get(clip.get("track"), {}).get("kind") == "visual"
   190	            for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   191	        )
   192	        if not has_visual_media_clip:
   193	            return False, "ffmpeg engine needs at least one visual media clip"
   194	    except Exception as exc:
   195	        return False, str(exc) or type(exc).__name__
   196	    return True, None
   197

   199	def can_render_with_ffmpeg_media(
   200	    timeline_path: Path,
   201	    assets_path: Path,
   202	) -> bool:
   203	    """Return the facade's legacy FFmpeg-media eligibility decision."""
   204	
   205	    accepted, _reason = _legacy_media_acceptance(timeline_path, assets_path)
   206	    return accepted

   212	def support(request: RenderRequest, *, workspace: Path) -> SupportReport:
   213	    """Load request files and delegate to the fail-closed evaluator."""
   214	
   215	    timeline_path = _input_path(request.timeline_path, workspace)
   216	    if request.assets_registry_path is None:
   217	        return _support_load_failure("rendering.ffmpeg requires an assets registry")
   218	    assets_path = _input_path(request.assets_registry_path, workspace)
   219	    try:
   220	        timeline_data = json.loads(timeline_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   221	        if not isinstance(timeline_data, dict):
   222	            raise ValueError("timeline must contain a JSON object")
   223	        assets = timeline.load_registry(assets_path)
   224	    except Exception as exc:
   225	        return _support_load_failure(str(exc) or type(exc).__name__)
   226	
   227	    localized = replace(
   228	        request,
   229	        timeline_path=str(timeline_path),
   230	        assets_registry_path=str(assets_path),
   231	    )
   232	    return strict_support(
   233	        localized,
   234	        timeline_data,
   235	        assets,
   236	        probe=ffprobe_metadata_strict,
   237	    )

   179	def _clip_duration_seconds(clip: dict) -> float:
   180	    start = float(clip.get("from", 0) or 0)
   181	    end = float(clip.get("to", start) or start)
   182	    speed = float(clip.get("speed", 1) or 1)
   183	    if speed <= 0:
   184	        raise ValueError(f"Clip {clip.get('id')!r} has non-positive speed {speed}")
   185	    return max(0.0, end - start) / speed

   188	def _clip_timeline_end_seconds(clip: dict) -> float:
   189	    start = float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0)
   190	    if clip.get("clipType") == "media":
   191	        return start + _clip_duration_seconds(clip)
   192	    hold = clip.get("hold")
   193	    if isinstance(hold, (int, float)):
   194	        return start + max(0.0, float(hold))
   195	    if isinstance(clip.get("to"), (int, float)):
   196	        return float(clip["to"])
   197	    return start
   198	
   199	
   200	def _timeline_duration_seconds(timeline_data: dict) -> float:
   201	    metadata = timeline_data.get("metadata", {})
   202	    explicit = metadata.get("duration_seconds") if isinstance(metadata, dict) else None
   203	    if not isinstance(explicit, (int, float)) and isinstance(metadata, dict):
   204	        explicit = metadata.get("expected_duration_seconds")
   205	    if isinstance(explicit, (int, float)):
   206	        return float(explicit)
   207	    return max((_clip_timeline_end_seconds(clip) for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])), default=0.0)

   210	def _round_frame_time(seconds: float, fps: int, *, mode: str) -> float:
   211	    frames = seconds * fps
   212	    if mode == "floor":
   213	        frame = int(frames // 1)
   214	    elif mode == "ceil":
   215	        frame = int(-(-frames // 1))
   216	    else:
   217	        frame = round(frames)
   218	    return frame / fps

   220	
   221	def _clip_overlaps(clip: dict, start: float, end: float) -> bool:
   222	    clip_start = float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0)
   223	    clip_end = _clip_timeline_end_seconds(clip)
   224	    return clip_start < end and clip_end > start
   225	
   226	
   227	def _window_clip(clip: dict, start: float, end: float) -> dict | None:
   228	    if not _clip_overlaps(clip, start, end):
   229	        return None
   230	    clip_start = float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0)
   231	    visible_start = max(clip_start, start)
   232	    visible_end = min(_clip_timeline_end_seconds(clip), end)
   233	    if visible_end <= visible_start:
   234	        return None
   235	
   236	    out = dict(clip)
   237	    out["at"] = visible_start - start
   238	    out["id"] = f"{clip.get('id', 'clip')}_{start:.3f}_{end:.3f}".replace(".", "_")
   239	    if clip.get("clipType") == "media":
   240	        speed = float(clip.get("speed", 1) or 1)
   241	        source_from = float(clip.get("from", 0) or 0) + ((visible_start - clip_start) * speed)
   242	        out["from"] = source_from
   243	        out["to"] = source_from + ((visible_end - visible_start) * speed)
   244	    elif isinstance(clip.get("hold"), (int, float)):
   245	        out["hold"] = visible_end - visible_start
   246	    return out
   247	
   248	
   249	def _window_timeline_data(timeline_data: dict, start: float, end: float, *, media_only: bool) -> dict:
   250	    clips: list[dict] = []
   251	    for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", []):
   252	        if media_only and clip.get("clipType") != "media":
   253	            continue
   254	        windowed = _window_clip(clip, start, end)
   255	        if windowed is not None:
   256	            clips.append(windowed)
   257	    used_tracks = {clip.get("track") for clip in clips}
   258	    tracks = [track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", []) if track.get("id") in used_tracks]
   259	    out = dict(timeline_data)
   260	    out["tracks"] = tracks
   261	    out["clips"] = clips
   262	    out["metadata"] = {
   263	        **dict(timeline_data.get("metadata", {})),
   264	        "source_window_start_seconds": start,
   265	        "source_window_end_seconds": end,
   266	        "duration_seconds": end - start,
   267	    }
   268	    return out

   270	
   271	def _validate_ffmpeg_media_timeline(timeline_data: dict) -> None:
   272	    tracks = {track.get("id"): track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])}
   273	    visual_tracks = [track for track in tracks.values() if track.get("kind") == "visual"]
   274	    audio_tracks = [track for track in tracks.values() if track.get("kind") == "audio"]
   275	    if len(visual_tracks) != 1:
   276	        raise ValueError("ffmpeg engine supports exactly one visual track")
   277	    for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", []):
   278	        if clip.get("clipType") != "media":
   279	            raise ValueError(f"ffmpeg engine only supports media clips, got {clip.get('clipType')!r}")
   280	        if float(clip.get("speed", 1) or 1) != 1.0:
   281	            raise ValueError("ffmpeg engine does not support speed changes yet")
   282	        track = tracks.get(clip.get("track"), {})
   283	        if track.get("kind") == "visual" and float(clip.get("volume", 0) or 0) != 0:
   284	            raise ValueError("ffmpeg engine expects visual clips to have muted embedded audio")
   285	    audio_track_ids = {track["id"] for track in audio_tracks}
   286	    audio_clips = sorted(
   287	        [clip for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", []) if clip.get("track") in audio_track_ids],
   288	        key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
   289	    )
   290	    cursor = 0.0
   291	    for clip in audio_clips:
   292	        at = float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0)
   293	        if at < cursor - 0.001:
   294	            raise ValueError("ffmpeg engine supports multiple audio tracks only when audio clips do not overlap")
   295	        cursor = max(cursor, at + _clip_duration_seconds(clip))
   296

   298	def _render_ffmpeg_media_to_path(timeline_path: Path, assets_path: Path, out_path: Path) -> Path:
   299	    if not timeline_path.exists():
   300	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Timeline missing: {timeline_path}")
   301	    if not assets_path.exists():
   302	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Asset registry missing: {assets_path}")
   303	    timeline_data = json.loads(timeline_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   304	    registry = timeline.load_registry(assets_path)
   305	    _validate_ffmpeg_media_timeline(timeline_data)
   306	    width, height, fps = _timeline_canvas(timeline_data)
   307	    tracks = {track.get("id"): track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])}
   308	    visual_track_ids = {track["id"] for track in tracks.values() if track.get("kind") == "visual"}
   309	    audio_track_ids = {track["id"] for track in tracks.values() if track.get("kind") == "audio"}
   310	    video_clips = sorted(
   311	        [clip for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", []) if clip.get("track") in visual_track_ids],
   312	        key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
   313	    )
   314	    audio_clips = sorted(
   315	        [clip for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", []) if clip.get("track") in audio_track_ids],
   316	        key=lambda clip: float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0),
   317	    )
   318	    if not video_clips:
   319	        raise ValueError("ffmpeg engine needs at least one visual media clip")
   320	
   321	    asset_keys: list[str] = []
   322	    for clip in [*video_clips, *audio_clips]:
   323	        asset_key = str(clip.get("asset") or "")
   324	        if not asset_key:
   325	            raise ValueError(f"Clip {clip.get('id')!r} has no asset")
   326	        if asset_key not in registry["assets"]:
   327	            raise ValueError(f"Clip {clip.get('id')!r} references unknown asset {asset_key!r}")
   328	        if asset_key not in asset_keys:
   329	            asset_keys.append(asset_key)
   330	
   331	    inputs: list[str] = []
   332	    for asset_key in asset_keys:
   333	        entry = registry["assets"][asset_key]
   334	        file_value = entry.get("file")
   335	        if not isinstance(file_value, str) or not file_value:
   336	            raise ValueError(f"ffmpeg engine requires local file assets; {asset_key!r} has no file")
   337	        asset_path = Path(file_value)
   338	        if not asset_path.is_absolute():
   339	            asset_path = (assets_path.parent / asset_path).resolve()
   340	        inputs.extend(["-i", str(asset_path)])
   341	    asset_index = {asset_key: index for index, asset_key in enumerate(asset_keys)}
   342	
   343	    filters: list[str] = []
   344	    video_labels: list[str] = []
   345	    copy_video_input: int | None = None
   346	    if len(video_clips) == 1:
   347	        clip = video_clips[0]
   348	        asset_key = str(clip["asset"])
   349	        entry = registry["assets"][asset_key]
   350	        source_duration = entry.get("duration")
   351	        source_resolution = entry.get("resolution")
   352	        start = float(clip.get("from", 0) or 0)
   353	        end = float(clip.get("to", start) or start)
   354	        at = float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0)
   355	        full_duration = isinstance(source_duration, (int, float)) and abs((end - start) - float(source_duration)) < 0.05
   356	        same_resolution = source_resolution == f"{width}x{height}"
   357	        no_visual_adjustments = not any(
   358	            key in clip
   359	            for key in ("x", "y", "width", "height", "cropTop", "cropBottom", "cropLeft", "cropRight", "effects", "transition")
   360	        )
   361	        if at == 0 and start == 0 and full_duration and same_resolution and no_visual_adjustments:
   362	            copy_video_input = asset_index[asset_key]
   363	    if copy_video_input is None:
   364	        for index, clip in enumerate(video_clips):
   365	            inp = asset_index[str(clip["asset"])]
   366	            start = float(clip.get("from", 0) or 0)
   367	            end = float(clip.get("to", start) or start)
   368	            label = f"v{index}"
   369	            filters.append(
   370	                f"[{inp}:v]trim=start={start:.6f}:end={end:.6f},setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,"
   371	                f"scale={width}:{height}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
   372	                f"pad={width}:{height}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,"
   373	                f"fps={fps},format=yuv420p[{label}]"
   374	            )
   375	            video_labels.append(f"[{label}]")
   376	        filters.append("".join(video_labels) + f"concat=n={len(video_labels)}:v=1:a=0[vout]")
   377	
   378	    audio_labels: list[str] = []
   379	    cursor = 0.0
   380	    audio_index = 0
   381	    for clip in audio_clips:
   382	        at = float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0)
   383	        if at > cursor + 0.001:
   384	            duration = at - cursor
   385	            label = f"a{audio_index}"
   386	            filters.append(f"anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo,atrim=duration={duration:.6f}[{label}]")
   387	            audio_labels.append(f"[{label}]")
   388	            audio_index += 1
   389	        inp = asset_index[str(clip["asset"])]
   390	        start = float(clip.get("from", 0) or 0)
   391	        end = float(clip.get("to", start) or start)
   392	        volume = float(clip.get("volume", 1) or 0)
   393	        label = f"a{audio_index}"
   394	        filters.append(
   395	            f"[{inp}:a]atrim=start={start:.6f}:end={end:.6f},"
   396	            f"asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo,"
   397	            f"volume={volume:.6f}[{label}]"
   398	        )
   399	        audio_labels.append(f"[{label}]")
   400	        cursor = at + _clip_duration_seconds(clip)
   401	        audio_index += 1
   402	    if not audio_labels:
   403	        duration = sum(_clip_duration_seconds(clip) for clip in video_clips)
   404	        filters.append(f"anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo,atrim=duration={duration:.6f}[a0]")
   405	        audio_labels.append("[a0]")
   406	    filters.append("".join(audio_labels) + f"concat=n={len(audio_labels)}:v=0:a=1[aout]")
   407	
   408	    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   409	    subprocess.run(
   410	        [
   411	            "ffmpeg",
   412	            "-hide_banner",
   413	            "-y",
   414	            *inputs,
   415	            "-filter_complex",
   416	            ";".join(filters),
   417	            "-map",
   418	            f"{copy_video_input}:v:0" if copy_video_input is not None else "[vout]",
   419	            "-map",
   420	            "[aout]",
   421	            "-c:v",
   422	            "copy" if copy_video_input is not None else "libx264",
   423	            *(["-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20"] if copy_video_input is None else []),
   424	            "-c:a",
   425	            "aac",
   426	            "-b:a",
   427	            "192k",
   428	            "-movflags",
   429	            "+faststart",
   430	            str(out_path),
   431	        ],
   432	        check=True,
   433	    )
   434	    return out_path

   437	def _render_ffmpeg_media(
   438	    timeline_path: Path,
   439	    assets_path: Path,
   440	    out_path: Path,
   441	    *,
   442	    _previous_outputs: Sequence[Path] | None = None,
   443	) -> Path:
   444	    """Render FFmpeg output privately, then publish the committed pair."""
   445	
   446	    publication_out = out_path  # unresolved: publication symlink-guards it
   447	    resolved_out = out_path.resolve()
   448	    resolved_out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   449	    with TemporaryDirectory(
   450	        prefix=f".{resolved_out.name}.publication-",
   451	        dir=str(resolved_out.parent),
   452	    ) as publication_tmp:
   453	        staged_video = Path(publication_tmp) / resolved_out.name
   454	        _render_ffmpeg_media_to_path(timeline_path, assets_path, staged_video)
   455	        provenance = _render_provenance_payload(
   456	            out_path,
   457	            engine="ffmpeg",
   458	            timeline_path=timeline_path,
   459	            assets_path=assets_path,
   460	            project_dir=REPO_ROOT / "remotion",
   461	            composition_id="TimelineComposition",
   462	            theme_path=None,
   463	            active_theme=None,
   464	            registry_state=_effective_registry_state(None),
   465	            stage_summary={"root": None, "effects": []},
   466	        )
   467	        output = publish_render_result(
   468	            staged_video,
   469	            provenance,
   470	            out_path=out_path,
   471	            sidecar_path=_render_provenance_sidecar_path(out_path),
   472	            previous_outputs=(
   473	                _PUBLICATION_PREVIOUS_OUTPUTS.get()
   474	                if _previous_outputs is None
   475	                else _previous_outputs
   476	            ),
   477	        )
   478	
   479	    audit = AuditContext.from_env()
   480	    if audit is not None:
   481	        timeline_id = audit.register_asset(kind="timeline", path=timeline_path, label="Render timeline", stage="render_ffmpeg")
   482	        assets_id = audit.register_asset(kind="assets_registry", path=assets_path, label="Render asset registry", stage="render_ffmpeg")
   483	        render_id = audit.register_asset(
   484	            kind="render",
   485	            path=output,
   486	            label="Rendered video",
   487	            parents=[timeline_id, assets_id],
   488	            stage="render_ffmpeg",
   489	            metadata={"engine": "ffmpeg"},
   490	        )
   491	        audit.register_node(
   492	            stage="render_ffmpeg",
   493	            label="Render media-only timeline with ffmpeg",
   494	            parents=[timeline_id, assets_id],
   495	            outputs=[render_id],
   496	            metadata={"engine": "ffmpeg"},
   497	        )
   498	    return output

   501	def _can_render_with_ffmpeg_media(timeline_path: Path, assets_path: Path) -> bool:
   502	    try:
   503	        timeline_data = json.loads(timeline_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   504	        timeline.load_registry(assets_path)
   505	        _validate_ffmpeg_media_timeline(timeline_data)
   506	        tracks = {track.get("id"): track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])}
   507	        has_visual_media_clip = any(
   508	            clip.get("clipType") == "media"
   509	            and tracks.get(clip.get("track"), {}).get("kind") == "visual"
   510	            for clip in timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   511	        )
   512	    except Exception:
   513	        return False
   514	    return has_visual_media_clip

   517	def _complex_clip_windows(timeline_data: dict, fps: int, *, handle_seconds: float = 0.25) -> list[tuple[float, float]]:
   518	    duration = _timeline_duration_seconds(timeline_data)
   519	    tracks = {track.get("id"): track for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", [])}
   520	    visual_track_ids = {track.get("id") for track in timeline_data.get("tracks", []) if track.get("kind") == "visual"}
   521	    visual_media_coverage: dict[str, float] = {}
   522	    for candidate in timeline_data.get("clips", []):
   523	        if candidate.get("clipType") != "media" or candidate.get("track") not in visual_track_ids:
   524	            continue
   525	        track_id = str(candidate.get("track"))
   526	        visual_media_coverage[track_id] = visual_media_coverage.get(track_id, 0.0) + _clip_duration_seconds(candidate)
   527	    base_visual_track_id = max(visual_media_coverage, key=visual_media_coverage.get) if visual_media_coverage else None
   528	    windows: list[tuple[float, float]] = []
   529	    clips = timeline_data.get("clips", [])
   530	    for index, clip in enumerate(clips):
   531	        media_clip = clip.get("clipType") == "media"
   532	        if media_clip:
   533	            track = tracks.get(clip.get("track"), {})
   534	            params = clip.get("params") if isinstance(clip.get("params"), dict) else {}
   535	            effects = clip.get("effects")
   536	            has_effects = bool(effects)
   537	            has_transition = bool(clip.get("transition"))
   538	            has_overlay_track = track.get("kind") == "visual" and clip.get("track") != base_visual_track_id
   539	            has_opacity = isinstance(clip.get("opacity"), (int, float)) and float(clip.get("opacity") or 0) != 1.0
   540	            has_audio_fade = track.get("kind") == "audio" and (
   541	                isinstance(params.get("fadeIn"), (int, float)) or isinstance(params.get("fadeOut"), (int, float))
   542	            )
   543	            if not (has_effects or has_transition or has_overlay_track or has_opacity or has_audio_fade):
   544	                continue
   545	            next_same_track = next(
   546	                (candidate for candidate in clips[index + 1 :] if candidate.get("track") == clip.get("track")),
   547	                None,
   548	            )
   549	            if has_transition and next_same_track is not None:
   550	                transition = clip.get("transition")
   551	                transition_seconds = 8 / fps
   552	                if isinstance(transition, dict):
   553	                    if isinstance(transition.get("duration"), (int, float)):
   554	                        transition_seconds = float(transition["duration"])
   555	                    elif isinstance(transition.get("durationFrames"), (int, float)):
   556	                        transition_seconds = float(transition["durationFrames"]) / fps
   557	                clip_end = _clip_timeline_end_seconds(clip)
   558	                next_start = float(next_same_track.get("at", clip_end) or clip_end)
   559	                start = max(0.0, min(clip_end - transition_seconds, next_start) - handle_seconds)
   560	                end = min(duration, max(clip_end, next_start + transition_seconds) + handle_seconds)
   561	                if end > start:
   562	                    windows.append(
   563	                        (
   564	                            _round_frame_time(start, fps, mode="floor"),
   565	                            _round_frame_time(end, fps, mode="ceil"),
   566	                        )
   567	                    )
   568	                continue
   569	        start = max(0.0, float(clip.get("at", 0) or 0) - handle_seconds)
   570	        end = min(duration, _clip_timeline_end_seconds(clip) + handle_seconds)
   571	        if end <= start:
   572	            continue
   573	        windows.append(
   574	            (
   575	                _round_frame_time(start, fps, mode="floor"),
   576	                _round_frame_time(end, fps, mode="ceil"),
   577	            )
   578	        )
   579	    if not windows:
   580	        return []
   581	    windows.sort()
   582	    merged: list[tuple[float, float]] = []
   583	    for start, end in windows:
   584	        if not merged or start > merged[-1][1]:
   585	            merged.append((start, end))
   586	        else:
   587	            merged[-1] = (merged[-1][0], max(merged[-1][1], end))
   588	    return merged

   137	def _evaluate(
   138	    tmp_path: Path,

   141	    *,

   144	    which=None,
   145	    request: RenderRequest | None = None,
   146	):
   147	    missing = missing_files or set()
   148	    for entry in assets.get("assets", {}).values():
   149	        file_value = entry.get("file")
   150	        if isinstance(file_value, str) and file_value not in missing:
