   110	def _safe_protocol_output_path(workspace: Path, output_name: str) -> Path:
   111	    """Resolve an invocation-owned output without following output symlinks."""
   112	
   113	    root = workspace.resolve(strict=True)
   114	    output_dir = root / "outputs"
   115	    if output_dir.is_symlink():
   116	        raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   117	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   118	            message="finalizer output directory must not be a symlink",
   119	            recovery_command="replace the outputs symlink with an invocation-owned directory",
   120	            details={"output_directory": "outputs"},
   121	        )
   122	    if output_dir.exists() and not output_dir.is_dir():
   123	        raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   124	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   125	            message="finalizer output parent is not a directory",
   126	            recovery_command="create an invocation-owned outputs directory",
   127	            details={"output_directory": "outputs"},
   128	        )
   129	    output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
   130	    resolved_dir = output_dir.resolve(strict=True)
   131	    try:
   132	        resolved_dir.relative_to(root)
   133	    except ValueError:
   134	        raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   135	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   136	            message="finalizer output directory escapes the invocation workspace",
   137	            recovery_command="use an invocation-owned outputs directory",
   138	            details={"output_directory": "outputs"},
   139	        )
   140	    if not resolved_dir.is_dir():
   141	        raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   142	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   143	            message="finalizer output parent is not a directory",
   144	            recovery_command="create an invocation-owned outputs directory",
   145	            details={"output_directory": "outputs"},
   146	        )
   147	
   148	    candidate = resolved_dir / output_name
   149	    if candidate.is_symlink():
   150	        raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   151	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   152	            message="finalizer output path must not be a symlink",
   153	            recovery_command="remove the output symlink and retry",
   154	            details={"output": output_name},
   155	        )
   156	    if candidate.exists() and not candidate.is_file():

   184	def _text(value: Any) -> str | None:
   185	    return value.strip().lower() if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() else None
   186	
   187	
   188	def _level(value: Any, *, codec: Any = None) -> str | None:
   189	    normalized = _text(value)
   190	    if normalized is None:
   191	        return None
   192	    if normalized.isdigit():
   193	        level_idc = int(normalized)
   194	        normalized_codec = _text(codec)
   195	        divisor = 10 if normalized_codec in {"h264", "avc", "avc1"} else None
   196	        if normalized_codec in {"hevc", "h265"}:
   197	            divisor = 30
   198	        if divisor is not None and level_idc >= divisor:
   199	            quotient = Fraction(level_idc, divisor)
   200	            if quotient.denominator == 1:
   201	                return f"{quotient.numerator}.0"
   202	            return f"{float(quotient):.1f}"
   203	    return normalized
   204

   206	def _same_value(
   207	    field: str,
   208	    actual: Any,
   209	    expected: Any,
   210	    *,
   211	    codec: Any = None,
   212	) -> bool:
   213	    if field in {"fps_rational", "time_base"}:
   214	        try:
   215	            return Fraction(*actual) == Fraction(*expected)
   216	        except (TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
   217	            return False
   218	    if field == "video_level":
   219	        return _level(actual, codec=codec) == _level(expected, codec=codec)
   220	    if field in {
   221	        "container",
   222	        "video_codec",
   223	        "video_profile",
   224	        "pixel_format",
   225	        "audio_codec",
   226	        "audio_channel_layout",
   227	    }:
   228	        return _text(actual) == _text(expected)
   229	    return actual == expected

   232	def _profile_differences(
   233	    actual: RenderProfile,
   234	    expected: RenderProfile,
   235	) -> list[_ProfileDifference]:
   236	    differences: list[_ProfileDifference] = []
   237	    for field in (
   238	        "width",
   239	        "height",
   240	        "fps_rational",
   241	        "time_base",
   242	        "container",
   243	        "video_codec",
   244	        "pixel_format",
   245	    ):
   246	        actual_value = getattr(actual, field)
   247	        expected_value = getattr(expected, field)
   248	        if not _same_value(field, actual_value, expected_value):
   249	            differences.append(_ProfileDifference(field, actual_value, expected_value))
   250	
   251	    # Null profile/level values are deliberately unconstrained in the V1
   252	    # artifact contract.  A concrete canonical value, however, must match.
   253	    for field in ("video_profile", "video_level"):
   254	        expected_value = getattr(expected, field)
   255	        actual_value = getattr(actual, field)
   256	        if expected_value is not None and not _same_value(
   257	            field,
   258	            actual_value,
   259	            expected_value,
   260	            codec=expected.video_codec,
   261	        ):
   262	            differences.append(_ProfileDifference(field, actual_value, expected_value))
   263	
   264	    if actual.has_audio != expected.has_audio:
   265	        differences.append(
   266	            _ProfileDifference(
   267	                "audio_presence",
   268	                "present" if actual.has_audio else "absent",
   269	                "present" if expected.has_audio else "absent",
   270	            )
   271	        )
   272	    elif expected.has_audio:
   273	        for field in (
   274	            "audio_codec",
   275	            "audio_sample_rate",
   276	            "audio_channel_layout",
   277	        ):
   278	            actual_value = getattr(actual, field)
   279	            expected_value = getattr(expected, field)
   280	            if not _same_value(field, actual_value, expected_value):
   281	                differences.append(
   282	                    _ProfileDifference(field, actual_value, expected_value)
   283	                )
   284	    return differences

   312	    if video_level is None:
   313	        video_level = next(
   314	            (
   315	                segment.profile.video_level
   316	                for segment in eligible
   317	                if segment.profile.video_level is not None
   318	            ),
   319	            None,
   320	        )
   321	    if (
   322	        video_profile == canonical.video_profile
   323	        and video_level == canonical.video_level
   324	    ):
   325	        return canonical
   326	    return replace(
   327	        canonical,
   328	        video_profile=video_profile,
   329	        video_level=video_level,
   330	    )
   331	
   332	
   333	def _format_value(value: Any) -> str:
   334	    if isinstance(value, tuple) and len(value) == 2:
   335	        return f"{value[0]}/{value[1]}"
   336	    if value is None:
   337	        return "null"
   338	    return str(value)
   339	
   340	
   341	def _normalization_record(
   342	    index: int,
   343	    difference: _ProfileDifference,
   344	) -> str:
   345	    return (
   346	        f"segment[{index}] {difference.field}: "
   347	        f"{_format_value(difference.actual)} -> "
   348	        f"{_format_value(difference.expected)}"
   349	    )
   350	
   351	
   352	def _validate_filter_token(value: str, label: str) -> str:
   353	    if not _SAFE_FILTER_TOKEN.fullmatch(value):
   354	        raise ValueError(f"{label} contains characters FFmpeg cannot safely parse")
   355	    return value
   356	
   357	
   358	def _video_encoder(codec: str) -> str:
   359	    normalized = _text(codec)
   360	    encoders = {
   361	        "h264": "libx264",
   362	        "avc": "libx264",
   363	        "avc1": "libx264",
   364	        "hevc": "libx265",
   365	        "h265": "libx265",
   366	        "mpeg4": "mpeg4",
   367	        "vp9": "libvpx-vp9",
   368	        "av1": "libaom-av1",
   369	    }
   370	    if normalized not in encoders:
   371	        raise_unsupported_error(
   372	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   373	            message=f"unsupported target video codec for FFmpeg finalization: {codec}",
   374	            recovery_command="select an FFmpeg-encodable canonical video profile",
   375	            details={"video_codec": codec},
   376	        )
   377	    return encoders[normalized]
   378	
   379	
   380	def _encoder_profile(codec: str, profile: str) -> str:
   381	    normalized_codec = _text(codec)
   382	    normalized_profile = _text(profile)
   383	    assert normalized_profile is not None
   384	    if normalized_codec in {"h264", "avc", "avc1"}:
   385	        return {
   386	            "baseline": "baseline",
   387	            "constrained baseline": "baseline",
   388	            "main": "main",
   389	            "high": "high",
   390	            "high 10": "high10",
   391	            "high 10 intra": "high10",
   392	            "high 4:2:2": "high422",
   393	            "high 4:2:2 intra": "high422",
   394	            "high 4:4:4": "high444",
   395	            "high 4:4:4 predictive": "high444",
   396	            "high 4:4:4 intra": "high444",
   397	        }.get(normalized_profile, normalized_profile)
   398	    if normalized_codec in {"hevc", "h265"}:
   399	        return {
   400	            "main": "main",
   401	            "main 10": "main10",
   402	            "main still picture": "mainstillpicture",
   403	        }.get(normalized_profile, normalized_profile.replace(" ", ""))
   404	    return normalized_profile
   405	
   406	
   407	def _audio_encoder(codec: str) -> str:
   408	    normalized = _text(codec)
   409	    encoders = {
   410	        "aac": "aac",
   411	        "mp3": "libmp3lame",
   412	        "opus": "libopus",
   413	        "ac3": "ac3",
   414	        "flac": "flac",
   415	        "pcm_s16le": "pcm_s16le",
   416	        "pcm_s24le": "pcm_s24le",
   417	    }
   418	    if normalized not in encoders:
   419	        raise_unsupported_error(
   420	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   421	            message=f"unsupported target audio codec for FFmpeg finalization: {codec}",
   422	            recovery_command="select an FFmpeg-encodable canonical audio profile",
   423	            details={"audio_codec": codec},
   424	        )
   425	    return encoders[normalized]
   426	
   427	
   428	def _mp4_timescale(profile: RenderProfile) -> int:
   429	    time_base = Fraction(*profile.time_base)
   430	    reciprocal = 1 / time_base
   431	    if reciprocal.denominator != 1:
   432	        raise_unsupported_error(
   433	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   434	            message=(
   435	                "MP4 finalization requires a reciprocal integer video time base; "
   436	                f"received {profile.time_base[0]}/{profile.time_base[1]}"
   437	            ),
   438	            recovery_command="resolve the canonical MP4 profile with Astrid's profile resolver",
   439	            details={"time_base": list(profile.time_base)},
   440	        )
   441	    return reciprocal.numerator
   442	
   443	
   444	def _validate_target_profile(profile: RenderProfile) -> None:
   445	    if _text(profile.container) != "mp4":
   446	        raise_unsupported_error(
   447	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   448	            message=f"FFmpeg finalizer supports canonical MP4 output, not {profile.container!r}",
   449	            recovery_command="select a finalizer supporting the canonical container",
   450	            details={"container": profile.container},
   451	        )
   452	    _video_encoder(profile.video_codec)
   453	    if profile.has_audio:
   454	        assert profile.audio_codec is not None
   455	        _audio_encoder(profile.audio_codec)
   456	    _mp4_timescale(profile)
   457	    _validate_filter_token(profile.pixel_format, "pixel_format")
   458	    if profile.audio_channel_layout is not None:
   459	        _validate_filter_token(profile.audio_channel_layout, "audio_channel_layout")
   460	
   461	
   462	def build_normalize_command(
   463	    segment: _PreparedSegment,
   464	    output_path: Path,
   465	    *,
   466	    target_profile: RenderProfile,
   467	    differences: Sequence[_ProfileDifference],
   468	    faststart: bool,
   469	) -> list[str]:
   470	    """Build one segment-normalization command without touching the filesystem."""
   471	
   472	    fields = {difference.field for difference in differences}
   473	    video_transcode = bool(fields & _VIDEO_TRANSCODE_FIELDS)
   474	    audio_transcode = bool(fields & _AUDIO_TRANSCODE_FIELDS)
   475	    fps = f"{target_profile.fps_rational[0]}/{target_profile.fps_rational[1]}"
   476	    time_base = f"{target_profile.time_base[0]}/{target_profile.time_base[1]}"
   477	
   478	    argv = [
   479	        "ffmpeg",
   480	        "-hide_banner",
   481	        "-y",
   482	        "-i",
   483	        str(segment.path),
   484	        "-map",
   485	        "0:v:0",
   486	    ]
   487	    if video_transcode:
   488	        filters = ["setpts=PTS-STARTPTS"]
   489	        if fields & {"width", "height"}:
   490	            filters.extend(
   491	                [
   492	                    (
   493	                        f"scale={target_profile.width}:{target_profile.height}:"
   494	                        "force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease"
   495	                    ),
   496	                    (
   497	                        f"pad={target_profile.width}:{target_profile.height}:"
   498	                        "(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2"
   499	                    ),
   500	                ]
   501	            )
   502	        if "fps_rational" in fields:
   503	            filters.append(f"fps={fps}")
   504	        if "time_base" in fields:
   505	            filters.append(f"settb=expr={time_base}")
   506	        if "pixel_format" in fields:
   507	            filters.append(f"format={target_profile.pixel_format}")
   508	        argv.extend(["-vf", ",".join(filters)])
   509	        encoder = _video_encoder(target_profile.video_codec)
   510	        argv.extend(["-c:v", encoder, "-r:v", fps, "-fps_mode", "cfr"])
   511	        if encoder in {"libx264", "libx265"}:
   512	            argv.extend(["-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20"])
   513	        if target_profile.video_profile is not None:
   514	            argv.extend(
   515	                [
   516	                    "-profile:v",
   517	                    _encoder_profile(
   518	                        target_profile.video_codec,
   519	                        target_profile.video_profile,
   520	                    ),
   520	                    ),
   521	                ]
   522	            )
   523	        if target_profile.video_level is not None:
   524	            argv.extend(
   525	                [
   526	                    "-level:v",
   527	                    _level(
   528	                        target_profile.video_level,
   529	                        codec=target_profile.video_codec,
   530	                    )
   531	                    or target_profile.video_level,
   532	                ]
   533	            )
   534	        argv.extend(["-pix_fmt", target_profile.pixel_format])
   535	    else:
   536	        argv.extend(["-c:v", "copy"])
   537	
   538	    if target_profile.has_audio:
   539	        assert target_profile.audio_codec is not None
   540	        assert target_profile.audio_sample_rate is not None
   541	        assert target_profile.audio_channel_layout is not None
   542	        argv.extend(["-map", "0:a:0"])
   543	        if audio_transcode:
   544	            audio_filter = (
   545	                "asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,"
   546	                f"aformat=sample_rates={target_profile.audio_sample_rate}:"
   547	                f"channel_layouts={target_profile.audio_channel_layout}"
   548	            )
   549	            argv.extend(
   550	                [
   551	                    "-af",
   552	                    audio_filter,
   553	                    "-c:a",
   554	                    _audio_encoder(target_profile.audio_codec),
   555	                ]
   556	            )
   557	        else:
   558	            argv.extend(["-c:a", "copy"])
   559	    else:
   560	        argv.append("-an")
   561	
   562	    argv.extend(
   563	        [
   564	            "-video_track_timescale",
   565	            str(_mp4_timescale(target_profile)),
   566	        ]
   567	    )
   568	    if faststart:
   569	        argv.extend(["-movflags", "+faststart"])
   570	    argv.extend(["-f", "mp4", str(output_path)])
   571	    return argv
   572	
   573	
   574	def build_concat_command(
   575	    list_path: Path,
   576	    output_path: Path,
   577	    *,
   578	    target_profile: RenderProfile,
   579	    faststart: bool,
   580	) -> list[str]:
   581	    """Build the final concat-demuxer stream-copy command."""
   582	
   583	    argv = [
   584	        "ffmpeg",
   585	        "-hide_banner",
   586	        "-y",
   587	        "-f",
   588	        "concat",
   589	        "-safe",
   590	        "0",
   591	        "-i",
   592	        str(list_path),
   593	        "-map",
   594	        "0:v:0",
   595	    ]
   596	    if target_profile.has_audio:
   597	        argv.extend(["-map", "0:a:0"])
   598	    else:
   599	        argv.append("-an")
   600	    argv.extend(
   601	        [
   602	            "-c",
   603	            "copy",
   604	            "-video_track_timescale",
   605	            str(_mp4_timescale(target_profile)),
   606	        ]
   607	    )
   608	    if faststart:
   609	        argv.extend(["-movflags", "+faststart"])
   610	    argv.extend(["-f", "mp4", str(output_path)])
   611	    return argv
   612	
   613	
   614	def _concat_file_line(path: Path) -> str:
   615	    # FFmpeg's concat demuxer uses shell-like single-quote escaping even though
   616	    # the command itself is never run through a shell.
   617	    resolved = str(path.resolve())
   618	    if "\n" in resolved or "\r" in resolved:
   619	        raise ValueError("FFmpeg concat input paths must not contain CR or LF")
   620	    escaped = resolved.replace("'", "'\\''")
   621	    return f"file '{escaped}'"
   622	
   623	
   624	def _run_checked(runner: Runner, argv: list[str]) -> None:
   625	    runner(argv, check=True)
   626	
   627	
   628	def _assemble_prepared_segments(
   629	    segments: Sequence[_PreparedSegment],
   630	    output_path: Path,
   631	    *,
   632	    target_profile: RenderProfile,
   633	    faststart: bool,
   634	    runner: Runner,
   635	) -> list[str]:
   636	    """Normalize incompatible segments and atomically assemble the output."""
   637	
   638	    if not segments:
   639	        raise ValueError("at least one segment is required for finalization")
   640	    _validate_target_profile(target_profile)
   641	    output_path = output_path.absolute()
   642	    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   643	    normalization: list[str] = []
   644	
   645	    with TemporaryDirectory(
   646	        prefix=f".{output_path.name}.ffmpeg-finalizer-",
   647	        dir=str(output_path.parent),
   648	    ) as tmp_text:
   649	        tmp_dir = Path(tmp_text)
   650	        concat_paths: list[Path] = []
   651	        for segment in segments:
   652	            differences = _profile_differences(segment.profile, target_profile)
   653	            if not differences:
   654	                concat_paths.append(segment.path)
   655	                continue
   656	            normalization.extend(
   657	                _normalization_record(segment.index, difference)
   658	                for difference in differences
   659	            )
   660	            normalized_path = (
   661	                tmp_dir / "normalized" / f"segment-{segment.index:04d}.mp4"
   662	            )
   663	            normalized_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   664	            command = build_normalize_command(
   665	                segment,
   666	                normalized_path,
   667	                target_profile=target_profile,
   668	                differences=differences,
   669	                faststart=faststart,
   670	            )
   671	            _run_checked(runner, command)
   672	            if not normalized_path.is_file() or normalized_path.stat().st_size <= 0:
   673	                raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   674	                    backend=BACKEND_ID,
   675	                    message=(
   676	                        f"FFmpeg did not produce normalized segment[{segment.index}]"
   677	                    ),
   678	                    recovery_command="rerun finalization in a fresh invocation workspace",
   679	                    details={"segment_index": segment.index},
   680	                )
   681	            concat_paths.append(normalized_path)
   682	
   683	        list_path = tmp_dir / "segments.ffconcat"
   684	        list_path.write_text(
   685	            "ffconcat version 1.0\n"
   686	            + "\n".join(_concat_file_line(path) for path in concat_paths)
   687	            + "\n",
   688	            encoding="utf-8",
   689	        )
   690	        staged_output = tmp_dir / "final" / output_path.name
   691	        staged_output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   692	        _run_checked(
   693	            runner,
   694	            build_concat_command(
   695	                list_path,
   696	                staged_output,
   697	                target_profile=target_profile,
   698	                faststart=faststart,
   699	            ),
   700	        )
   701	        if not staged_output.is_file() or staged_output.stat().st_size <= 0:
   702	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   703	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
   704	                message="FFmpeg did not produce a finalized video",
   705	                recovery_command="rerun finalization in a fresh invocation workspace",
   706	                details={"output": output_path.name},
   707	            )
   708	        os.replace(staged_output, output_path)
   709	    return normalization
   710	
   711	
   712	def _duration_fraction(probe: MediaProbe) -> Fraction:
   713	    if probe.duration_rational is not None:
   714	        try:
   715	            duration = Fraction(*probe.duration_rational)
   716	        except (TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError) as exc:
   717	            raise MediaProbeError("ffprobe returned an invalid rational duration") from exc
   718	    elif probe.duration_seconds is not None:
   719	        try:
   720	            duration = Fraction(str(probe.duration_seconds))
   721	        except (ValueError, ZeroDivisionError) as exc:
   722	            raise MediaProbeError("ffprobe returned an invalid duration") from exc
   723	    else:
   724	        raise MediaProbeError("ffprobe did not report media duration")
   725	    if duration <= 0:
   726	        raise MediaProbeError("ffprobe reported a non-positive media duration")
   727	    return duration
   728	
   729	
   730	def _required_probe_value(value: Any, label: str) -> Any:
   731	    if value is None:
   732	        raise MediaProbeError(f"ffprobe did not report {label}")
   733	    return value
   734	
   735	
   736	def _layout_from_probe(probe: MediaProbe) -> str | None:
   737	    if probe.audio_channel_layout is not None:
   738	        return probe.audio_channel_layout
   739	    return {
   740	        1: "mono",
   741	        2: "stereo",
   742	        6: "5.1",
   743	        8: "7.1",
   744	    }.get(probe.audio_channels)
   745	
   746	
   747	def _profile_from_probe(
   748	    probe: MediaProbe,
   749	    *,
   750	    ownership: AudioOwnership,
   751	    duration_tolerance: int,
   752	) -> RenderProfile:
   753	    if not probe.has_video_stream:
   754	        raise MediaProbeError("media has no video stream")
   755	    if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED and not probe.has_audio_stream:
   756	        raise MediaProbeError("media has no required audio stream")
   757	    if ownership is not AudioOwnership.RENDERED and probe.has_audio_stream:
   758	        raise MediaProbeError(
   759	            f"visual-only {ownership.value} media unexpectedly contains audio"
   760	        )
   761	    return RenderProfile(
   762	        width=_required_probe_value(probe.width, "video width"),
   763	        height=_required_probe_value(probe.height, "video height"),
   764	        fps_rational=_required_probe_value(probe.fps_rational, "video frame rate"),
   765	        time_base=_required_probe_value(probe.time_base, "video time base"),
   766	        container=_required_probe_value(probe.container, "container"),
   767	        video_codec=_required_probe_value(probe.video_codec, "video codec"),
   768	        video_profile=probe.video_profile,
   769	        video_level=probe.video_level,
   770	        pixel_format=_required_probe_value(probe.pixel_format, "pixel format"),
   771	        audio_codec=(
   772	            _required_probe_value(probe.audio_codec, "audio codec")
   773	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   774	            else None
   775	        ),
   776	        audio_sample_rate=(
   777	            _required_probe_value(probe.audio_sample_rate, "audio sample rate")
   778	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   779	            else None
   780	        ),
   781	        audio_channel_layout=(
   782	            _required_probe_value(_layout_from_probe(probe), "audio channel layout")
   783	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   784	            else None
   785	        ),
   786	        duration_tolerance=duration_tolerance,
   787	    )
   788	
   789	
   790	def _duration_frames_from_probe(probe: MediaProbe, profile: RenderProfile) -> int:
   791	    frames = _duration_fraction(probe) * Fraction(*profile.fps_rational)
   792	    return max(1, int(frames + Fraction(1, 2)))
   793	
   794	
   795	def concat_segment_files(
   796	    segment_paths: Sequence[Path],
   797	    output_path: Path,
   798	    *,
   799	    profile: RenderProfile | None = None,
   800	    audio: AudioOwnership | str | None = None,
   801	    faststart: bool = True,
   802	    runner: Runner | None = None,
   803	    probe: Probe | None = None,
   804	) -> list[str]:
   805	    """Strictly probe and assemble explicit files for the legacy facade.
   806	
   807	    Protocol callers use :func:`finalize`; this helper exists so hybrid
   808	    rendering can keep its historical two-argument concat seam while sharing
   809	    the finalizer's normalization implementation.
   810	    """
   811	
   812	    execute = subprocess.run if runner is None else runner
   813	    inspect = ffprobe_metadata_strict if probe is None else probe
   814	    paths = [Path(path).resolve() for path in segment_paths]
   815	    if not paths:
   816	        raise ValueError("at least one segment is required for finalization")
   817	    probes = [inspect(path) for path in paths]
   818	
   819	    if audio is None:
   820	        ownership = (
   821	            AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   822	            if (profile is not None and profile.has_audio)
   823	            or (profile is None and probes[0].has_audio_stream)
   824	            else AudioOwnership.NONE
   825	        )
   826	    else:
   827	        ownership = audio if isinstance(audio, AudioOwnership) else AudioOwnership(audio)
   828	
   829	    if profile is None:
   830	        first_profile = _profile_from_probe(
   831	            probes[0],
   832	            ownership=ownership,
   833	            duration_tolerance=1,
   834	        )
   835	        target_profile = (
   836	            first_profile
   837	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   838	            else _profile_without_audio(first_profile)
   839	        )
   840	    else:
   841	        target_profile = (
   842	            profile
   843	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   844	            else _profile_without_audio(profile)
   845	        )
   846	
   847	    prepared: list[_PreparedSegment] = []
   848	    for index, (path, media_probe) in enumerate(zip(paths, probes, strict=True)):
   849	        source_ownership = (
   850	            AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   851	            if media_probe.has_audio_stream
   852	            else (
   853	                AudioOwnership.PASSTHROUGH
   854	                if ownership is AudioOwnership.PASSTHROUGH
   855	                else AudioOwnership.NONE
   856	            )
   857	        )
   858	        source_profile = _profile_from_probe(
   859	            media_probe,
   860	            ownership=source_ownership,
   861	            duration_tolerance=target_profile.duration_tolerance,
   862	        )
   863	        if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED and source_ownership is not AudioOwnership.RENDERED:
   864	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   865	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
   866	                message=f"segment[{index}] is missing audio required by rendered mode",
   867	                recovery_command="render every segment with canonical audio and retry",
   868	                details={"segment_index": index, "audio_ownership": ownership.value},
   869	            )
   870	        prepared.append(
   871	            _PreparedSegment(
   872	                index=index,
   873	                path=path,
   874	                profile=source_profile,
   875	                audio=source_ownership,
   876	                duration_frames=_duration_frames_from_probe(media_probe, source_profile),
   877	            )
   878	        )
   879	
   880	    assembly_profile = _assembly_profile(target_profile, prepared)
   881	    published = False
   882	    try:
   883	        normalization = _assemble_prepared_segments(
   884	            prepared,
   885	            Path(output_path),
   886	            target_profile=assembly_profile,
   887	            faststart=faststart,
   888	            runner=execute,
   889	        )
   890	        published = True
   891	        final_probe = inspect(Path(output_path))
   892	        final_profile = _profile_from_probe(
   893	            final_probe,
   894	            ownership=ownership,
   895	            duration_tolerance=assembly_profile.duration_tolerance,
   896	        )
   897	        remaining = _profile_differences(final_profile, assembly_profile)
   898	        if remaining:
   899	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   900	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
   901	                message="finalized video does not match the requested canonical profile",
   902	                recovery_command="rerun finalization in a fresh invocation workspace",

   921	def _config(mapping: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
   922	    config = dict(mapping.get(BACKEND_ID, {}))
   923	    reasons: list[str] = []
   924	    unknown = sorted(set(config) - _CONFIG_KEYS)
   925	    if unknown:
   926	        reasons.append(f"unknown {BACKEND_ID} configuration: {', '.join(unknown)}")
   927	    faststart = config.get("faststart", True)
   928	    if not isinstance(faststart, bool):
   929	        reasons.append("faststart must be a boolean")
   930	        faststart = True
   931	    return faststart, reasons

   934	def support(request: RenderRequest, *, workspace: Path) -> SupportReport:
   935	    """Return request-sensitive support evidence for canonical finalization."""
   936	
   937	    del workspace  # Support is profile/config sensitive; it does not read inputs.
   938	    _faststart, reasons = _config(request.backend_config)
   939	    if request.profile is not None:
   940	        try:
   941	            _validate_target_profile(request.profile)
   942	        except RendererException as exc:
   943	            reasons.append(exc.error.message)
   944	        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   945	            reasons.append(str(exc))
   946	    for binary in ("ffmpeg", "ffprobe"):
   947	        if shutil.which(binary) is None:
   948	            reasons.append(f"required binary is unavailable: {binary}")
   949	    requested_audio = request.audio.value if request.audio is not None else "request-dependent"
   950	    return SupportReport(
   951	        schema_version=SCHEMA_VERSION,
   952	        supported=not reasons,
   953	        reasons=reasons,
   954	        features={
   955	            "strict_probe": True,
   956	            "stream_copy": True,
   957	            "profile_normalization": True,
   958	            "preserves_attachments": True,
   959	            "audio_ownership": requested_audio,
   960	        },
   961	        alternatives=[],
   962	        backend=BACKEND_ID,
   963	        backend_version=BACKEND_VERSION,
   964	    )

   967	def _final_audio_ownership(request: FinalizeRequest) -> AudioOwnership:
   968	    ownerships = [artifact.audio for artifact in request.artifacts]
   969	    for index, ownership in enumerate(ownerships):
   970	        if ownership is None:
   971	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   972	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
   973	                message=f"segment[{index}] does not declare audio ownership",
   974	                recovery_command="rerender the segment with explicit audio ownership",
   975	                details={"segment_index": index},
   976	            )
   977	
   978	    if request.plan.profile.has_audio:
   979	        if all(ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED for ownership in ownerships):
   980	            return AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   981	        if all(ownership is AudioOwnership.PASSTHROUGH for ownership in ownerships):
   982	            return AudioOwnership.PASSTHROUGH
   983	        raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   984	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   985	            message=(
   986	                "canonical audio requires every segment to provide rendered audio "
   987	                "or every segment to declare passthrough"
   988	            ),
   989	            recovery_command="rerender all segments with one consistent audio ownership mode",
   990	            details={
   991	                "audio_ownership": [
   992	                    ownership.value if ownership is not None else None
   993	                    for ownership in ownerships
   994	                ]
   995	            },
   996	        )
   997	
   998	    if any(ownership is AudioOwnership.PASSTHROUGH for ownership in ownerships):
   999	        raise_invalid_artifact_error(
  1000	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
  1001	            message="passthrough audio is incompatible with a visual-only canonical profile",
  1002	            recovery_command="use audio_ownership='none' for visual-only segments",
  1003	            details={"canonical_audio": False},
  1004	        )
  1005	    return AudioOwnership.NONE

  1008	def _preflight_segments(
  1009	    request: FinalizeRequest,
  1010	    *,
  1011	    workspace: Path,
  1012	) -> list[_PreparedSegment]:
  1013	    prepared: list[_PreparedSegment] = []
  1014	    canonical_fps = Fraction(*request.plan.profile.fps_rational)
  1015	    tolerance = request.plan.profile.duration_tolerance
  1016	    for index, (artifact, plan_segment) in enumerate(
  1017	        zip(request.artifacts, request.plan.segments, strict=True)
  1018	    ):
  1019	        if artifact.audio is None:
  1020	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
  1021	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
  1022	                message=f"segment[{index}] does not declare audio ownership",
  1023	                recovery_command="rerender the segment with explicit audio ownership",
  1024	                details={"segment_index": index},
  1025	            )
  1026	        segment_result = RenderResult(
  1027	            schema_version=SCHEMA_VERSION,
  1028	            video=artifact,
  1029	            audio_ownership=artifact.audio,
  1030	        )
  1031	        # Validate against the segment's own declared/probed profile.  Its
  1032	        # differences from the plan profile are legitimate normalization work.
  1033	        validate_render_result(
  1034	            segment_result,
  1035	            expected_profile=artifact.profile,
  1036	            workspace_root=workspace,
  1037	        )
  1038	
  1039	        artifact_seconds = Fraction(artifact.duration_frames, 1) / Fraction(
  1040	            *artifact.profile.fps_rational
  1040	            *artifact.profile.fps_rational
  1041	        )
  1042	        planned_seconds = Fraction(plan_segment.window.duration_frames, 1) / canonical_fps
  1043	        delta_frames = abs(artifact_seconds - planned_seconds) * canonical_fps
  1044	        if delta_frames > tolerance:
  1045	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
  1046	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
  1047	                message=(
  1048	                    f"segment[{index}] duration does not match its planned frame window"
  1049	                ),
  1050	                recovery_command="rerender the exact planned segment window and retry",
  1051	                details={
  1052	                    "segment_index": index,
  1053	                    "declared_duration_frames": artifact.duration_frames,
  1054	                    "planned_duration_frames": plan_segment.window.duration_frames,
  1055	                    "canonical_delta_frames": [
  1056	                        delta_frames.numerator,
  1057	                        delta_frames.denominator,
  1058	                    ],
  1059	                    "tolerance_frames": tolerance,
  1060	                },
  1061	            )
  1062	
  1063	        try:
  1064	            media_probe = ffprobe_metadata_strict(_input_path(artifact.path, workspace))
  1065	            probed_profile = _profile_from_probe(
  1066	                media_probe,
  1067	                ownership=artifact.audio,
  1068	                duration_tolerance=artifact.profile.duration_tolerance,
  1069	            )
  1070	        except (MediaProbeError, OSError, RuntimeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
  1071	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
  1072	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
  1073	                message=f"segment[{index}] strict media probe failed: {exc}",
  1074	                recovery_command="rerender the segment as a valid canonical media artifact",
  1075	                details={"segment_index": index},
  1076	            )
  1077	
  1078	        prepared.append(
  1079	            _PreparedSegment(
  1080	                index=index,
  1081	                path=_input_path(artifact.path, workspace),
  1082	                profile=probed_profile,
  1083	                audio=artifact.audio,
  1084	                duration_frames=artifact.duration_frames,
  1085	            )
  1086	        )
  1087	    return prepared

  1090	def _probe_normalized_segments(
  1091	    prepared: Sequence[_PreparedSegment],
  1092	    *,
  1093	    target_profile: RenderProfile,
  1094	) -> RenderProfile:
  1095	    """Strictly probe every normalized segment before final assembly."""
  1096	
  1097	    probed: list[_PreparedSegment] = []
  1098	    for segment in prepared:
  1099	        try:
  1100	            probe = ffprobe_metadata_strict(segment.path)
  1101	            profile = _profile_from_probe(
  1102	                probe,
  1103	                ownership=segment.audio,
  1104	                duration_tolerance=target_profile.duration_tolerance,
  1105	            )
  1106	        except (MediaProbeError, OSError, RuntimeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
  1107	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
  1108	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
  1109	                message=(
  1110	                    f"normalized segment[{segment.index}] could not be validated: {exc}"
  1111	                ),
  1112	                recovery_command="rerun finalization in a fresh invocation workspace",
  1113	                details={"segment_index": segment.index},
  1114	            )
  1115	        probed.append(replace(segment, profile=profile))
  1116	
  1117	    effective_profile = _assembly_profile(target_profile, probed)
  1118	    for segment in probed:
  1119	        differences = _profile_differences(segment.profile, effective_profile)
  1120	        if differences:
  1121	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
  1122	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
  1123	                message=(
  1124	                    f"normalized segment[{segment.index}] does not match the canonical profile"
  1125	                ),
  1126	                recovery_command="rerun finalization in a fresh invocation workspace",
  1127	                details={
  1128	                    "segment_index": segment.index,
  1129	                    "mismatches": [
  1130	                        _normalization_record(segment.index, difference)
  1131	                        for difference in differences
  1132	                    ],
  1133	                },
  1134	            )
  1135	    return effective_profile

  1138	def finalize(
  1139	    request: FinalizeRequest,
  1140	    *,
  1141	    workspace: Path,
  1142	    runner: Runner | None = None,
  1143	) -> RenderResult:
  1144	    """Preflight, normalize, concatenate, and validate one render plan."""
  1145	
  1146	    execute = subprocess.run if runner is None else runner
  1147	    if request.plan.finalizer.id != BACKEND_ID:
  1148	        raise ValueError(
  1149	            f"finalize request selects {request.plan.finalizer.id!r}, not {BACKEND_ID!r}"
  1150	        )
  1151	    faststart, config_reasons = _config(request.backend_config)
  1152	    if config_reasons:
  1153	        raise ValueError("; ".join(config_reasons))

  1157	    ownership = _final_audio_ownership(request)
  1158	    target_profile = (
  1159	        request.plan.profile
  1160	        if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
  1161	        else _profile_without_audio(request.plan.profile)
  1162	    )

  1164	    _validate_target_profile(assembly_profile)
  1165	    output_path = _safe_protocol_output_path(workspace, request.output_name)
  1166	    total_frames = sum(
  1167	        segment.window.duration_frames for segment in request.plan.segments
  1168	    )
  1169	    recovery_tmp = TemporaryDirectory(
  1170	        prefix=f".{output_path.name}.ffmpeg-finalizer-recovery-",
  1171	        dir=str(output_path.parent),
  1172	    )
  1173	    previous_output = (
  1174	        Path(recovery_tmp.name) / "previous-output.mp4"
  1175	        if output_path.is_file()
  1176	        else None
  1177	    )
  1178	    if previous_output is not None:
  1179	        shutil.copy2(output_path, previous_output)
  1180	    published = False
  1181	    assembly_started = False
  1182	    try:
  1183	        with TemporaryDirectory(
  1184	            prefix=f".{output_path.name}.ffmpeg-finalizer-normalize-",
  1185	            dir=str(output_path.parent),
  1186	        ) as normalized_tmp_text:
  1187	            normalized_tmp = Path(normalized_tmp_text)
  1188	            normalized_prepared: list[_PreparedSegment] = []
  1189	            normalization: list[str] = []
  1190	            for segment in prepared:
  1191	                differences = _profile_differences(segment.profile, assembly_profile)
  1192	                if not differences:
  1193	                    normalized_prepared.append(segment)
  1194	                    continue
  1195	                normalization.extend(
  1196	                    _normalization_record(segment.index, difference)
  1197	                    for difference in differences
  1198	                )
  1199	                normalized_path = normalized_tmp / f"segment-{segment.index:04d}.mp4"
  1200	                normalized_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  1201	                _run_checked(
  1202	                    execute,
  1203	                    build_normalize_command(
  1204	                        segment,
  1205	                        normalized_path,
  1206	                        target_profile=assembly_profile,
  1207	                        differences=differences,
  1208	                        faststart=faststart,
  1209	                    ),
  1210	                )
  1211	                if not normalized_path.is_file() or normalized_path.stat().st_size <= 0:
  1212	                    raise_invalid_artifact_error(
  1213	                        backend=BACKEND_ID,
  1214	                        message=(
  1215	                            f"FFmpeg did not produce normalized segment[{segment.index}]"
  1216	                        ),
  1217	                        recovery_command="rerun finalization in a fresh invocation workspace",
  1218	                        details={"segment_index": segment.index},
  1219	                    )
  1220	                normalized_prepared.append(
  1221	                    _PreparedSegment(
  1222	                        index=segment.index,
  1223	                        path=normalized_path,
  1224	                        profile=assembly_profile,
  1225	                        audio=ownership,
  1226	                        duration_frames=segment.duration_frames,
  1227	                    )
  1228	                )
  1229	            effective_profile = _probe_normalized_segments(
  1230	                normalized_prepared,
  1231	                target_profile=assembly_profile,
  1232	            )
  1233	            for segment in prepared:
  1234	                if not _profile_differences(segment.profile, assembly_profile):

  1239	                    effective_profile,

  1250	            # call performs only the concat-demuxer stream-copy assembly.
  1251	            assembly_started = True

  1253	                normalized_prepared,
  1254	                output_path,
  1255	                target_profile=effective_profile,
  1256	                faststart=faststart,
  1257	                runner=execute,
  1258	            )
  1259	            published = True
  1260	            normalization.extend(extra_normalization)
  1261	        video = VideoArtifact.from_file(
  1262	            path=output_path,
  1263	            workspace_root=workspace,
  1264	            profile=effective_profile,
  1265	            duration_frames=total_frames,
  1266	            audio=ownership,
  1267	            attachments=request.expected_attachments,

  1274	                BACKEND_ID: {

  1276	                    "finalizer_version": BACKEND_VERSION,

  1288	                    "audio_mode": ownership.value,

  1291	            normalization=normalization,
  1292	            logs=[],
  1293	            metadata=request.metadata,
  1294	        )

  1297	            result,
  1298	            expected_profile=request.plan.profile,
  1299	            workspace_root=workspace,
  1300	        )

  1302	    except BaseException:

  1304	            if previous_output is not None and previous_output.is_file():
  1305	                os.replace(previous_output, output_path)
  1306	            elif published or output_path.exists():
  1307	                output_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
  1308	        raise
  1309	    finally:
  1310	        recovery_tmp.cleanup()

  1313	def _load_finalize_request(path: Path) -> FinalizeRequest:
  1314	    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
  1315	    if not isinstance(payload, Mapping):
  1316	        raise TypeError("finalize request must contain a JSON object")
  1317	    return FinalizeRequest.from_dict(payload)
  1318	
  1319	
  1320	def _load_support_request(path: Path) -> RenderRequest:
  1321	    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
  1322	    if not isinstance(payload, Mapping):
  1323	        raise TypeError("support request must contain a JSON object")
  1324	    return RenderRequest.from_dict(payload).for_backend(BACKEND_ID)
  1325	
  1326	
  1327	def _write_failure(result_path: Path, exc: BaseException, *, kind: str) -> None:
  1328	    if isinstance(exc, RendererException):
  1329	        error_kind = exc.error.kind
  1330	        message = exc.error.message
  1331	        recovery = exc.error.recovery_command
  1332	        details = exc.error.details
  1333	    else:
  1334	        error_kind = kind
  1335	        message = str(exc) or type(exc).__name__
  1336	        recovery = None
  1337	        details = {"error_type": type(exc).__name__}
  1338	    error = make_renderer_error(
  1339	        error_kind,
  1340	        backend=BACKEND_ID,
  1341	        message=message,
  1342	        recovery_command=recovery,
  1343	        details=details,
  1344	    )
  1345	    write_json_atomic(result_path, error.to_dict())
  1346	
  1347	
  1348	def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
  1349	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
  1350	    parser.add_argument("verb", choices=("finalize", "support"))
  1351	    parser.add_argument("--request", type=Path, required=True)
  1352	    parser.add_argument("--result", type=Path, required=True)
  1353	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
  1354	
  1355	    try:
  1356	        request_path = args.request.resolve(strict=True)
  1357	        result_path = args.result.resolve()
  1358	        if request_path == result_path:
  1359	            raise ValueError("--request and --result must be different paths")
  1360	        request: FinalizeRequest | RenderRequest
  1361	        if args.verb == "finalize":
  1362	            request = _load_finalize_request(request_path)
  1363	        else:
  1364	            request = _load_support_request(request_path)
  1365	    except (
  1366	        OSError,
  1367	        ValueError,
  1368	        TypeError,
  1369	        json.JSONDecodeError,
  1370	        RendererException,
  1371	    ) as exc:
  1372	        _write_failure(args.result.resolve(), exc, kind="protocol")
  1373	        return 0
  1374	
  1375	    try:
  1376	        workspace = request_path.parent
  1377	        response: RenderResult | SupportReport
  1378	        if args.verb == "support":
  1379	            assert isinstance(request, RenderRequest)
  1380	            response = support(request, workspace=workspace)
  1381	        else:
  1382	            assert isinstance(request, FinalizeRequest)
  1383	            response = finalize(request, workspace=workspace)
  1384	        write_json_atomic(result_path, response.to_dict())
  1385	    except RendererException as exc:
  1386	        _write_failure(result_path, exc, kind=exc.error.kind)
  1387	    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
  1388	        _write_failure(result_path, exc, kind="binary_missing")
  1389	    except (ValueError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
  1390	        _write_failure(result_path, exc, kind="protocol")
  1391	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
  1392	        _write_failure(result_path, exc, kind="timeout")
  1393	    except BaseException as exc:
  1394	        if isinstance(exc, (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit)):
  1395	            raise
  1396	        _write_failure(result_path, exc, kind="internal")
  1397	    return 0
  1398	
  1399	
  1400	if __name__ == "__main__":
  1401	    raise SystemExit(main())
  1402	
  1403	
  1404	__all__ = [
  1405	    "BACKEND_ID",
  1406	    "BACKEND_VERSION",
  1407	    "FINALIZER_ID",
  1408	    "build_concat_command",
  1409	    "build_normalize_command",
  1410	    "concat_segment_files",
  1411	    "finalize",
  1412	    "main",

   398	    if normalized_codec in {"hevc", "h265"}:
   399	        return {
   400	            "main": "main",
   401	            "main 10": "main10",
   402	            "main still picture": "mainstillpicture",
   403	        }.get(normalized_profile, normalized_profile.replace(" ", ""))
   404	    return normalized_profile
   405	
   406	
   407	def _audio_encoder(codec: str) -> str:
   408	    normalized = _text(codec)
   409	    encoders = {
   410	        "aac": "aac",
   411	        "mp3": "libmp3lame",
   412	        "opus": "libopus",
   413	        "ac3": "ac3",
   414	        "flac": "flac",
   415	        "pcm_s16le": "pcm_s16le",
   416	        "pcm_s24le": "pcm_s24le",
   417	    }
   418	    if normalized not in encoders:
   419	        raise_unsupported_error(
   420	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   421	            message=f"unsupported target audio codec for FFmpeg finalization: {codec}",
   422	            recovery_command="select an FFmpeg-encodable canonical audio profile",
   423	            details={"audio_codec": codec},
   424	        )
   425	    return encoders[normalized]
   426	
   427	
   428	def _mp4_timescale(profile: RenderProfile) -> int:
   429	    time_base = Fraction(*profile.time_base)
   430	    reciprocal = 1 / time_base
   431	    if reciprocal.denominator != 1:
   432	        raise_unsupported_error(
   433	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   434	            message=(
   435	                "MP4 finalization requires a reciprocal integer video time base; "
   436	                f"received {profile.time_base[0]}/{profile.time_base[1]}"
   437	            ),
   438	            recovery_command="resolve the canonical MP4 profile with Astrid's profile resolver",
   439	            details={"time_base": list(profile.time_base)},
   440	        )
   441	    return reciprocal.numerator
   442	
   443	
   444	def _validate_target_profile(profile: RenderProfile) -> None:
   445	    if _text(profile.container) != "mp4":
   446	        raise_unsupported_error(
   447	            backend=BACKEND_ID,
   448	            message=f"FFmpeg finalizer supports canonical MP4 output, not {profile.container!r}",
   449	            recovery_command="select a finalizer supporting the canonical container",
   450	            details={"container": profile.container},
   451	        )
   452	    _video_encoder(profile.video_codec)
   453	    if profile.has_audio:
   454	        assert profile.audio_codec is not None
   455	        _audio_encoder(profile.audio_codec)
   456	    _mp4_timescale(profile)
   457	    _validate_filter_token(profile.pixel_format, "pixel_format")
   458	    if profile.audio_channel_layout is not None:
   459	        _validate_filter_token(profile.audio_channel_layout, "audio_channel_layout")
   460	
   461	
   462	def build_normalize_command(
   463	    segment: _PreparedSegment,
   464	    output_path: Path,
   465	    *,
   466	    target_profile: RenderProfile,
   467	    differences: Sequence[_ProfileDifference],
   468	    faststart: bool,
   469	) -> list[str]:
   470	    """Build one segment-normalization command without touching the filesystem."""
   471	
   472	    fields = {difference.field for difference in differences}
   473	    video_transcode = bool(fields & _VIDEO_TRANSCODE_FIELDS)
   474	    audio_transcode = bool(fields & _AUDIO_TRANSCODE_FIELDS)
   475	    fps = f"{target_profile.fps_rational[0]}/{target_profile.fps_rational[1]}"
   476	    time_base = f"{target_profile.time_base[0]}/{target_profile.time_base[1]}"
   477	
   478	    argv = [
   479	        "ffmpeg",
   480	        "-hide_banner",
   481	        "-y",
   482	        "-i",
   483	        str(segment.path),
   484	        "-map",
   485	        "0:v:0",
   486	    ]
   487	    if video_transcode:
   488	        filters = ["setpts=PTS-STARTPTS"]
   489	        if fields & {"width", "height"}:
   490	            filters.extend(
   491	                [
   492	                    (
   493	                        f"scale={target_profile.width}:{target_profile.height}:"
   494	                        "force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease"
   495	                    ),
   496	                    (
   497	                        f"pad={target_profile.width}:{target_profile.height}:"
   498	                        "(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2"
   499	                    ),
   500	                ]
   501	            )
   502	        if "fps_rational" in fields:
   503	            filters.append(f"fps={fps}")
   504	        if "time_base" in fields:
   505	            filters.append(f"settb=expr={time_base}")
   506	        if "pixel_format" in fields:
   507	            filters.append(f"format={target_profile.pixel_format}")
   508	        argv.extend(["-vf", ",".join(filters)])
   509	        encoder = _video_encoder(target_profile.video_codec)
   510	        argv.extend(["-c:v", encoder, "-r:v", fps, "-fps_mode", "cfr"])
   511	        if encoder in {"libx264", "libx265"}:
   512	            argv.extend(["-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20"])
   513	        if target_profile.video_profile is not None:
   514	            argv.extend(
   515	                [
   516	                    "-profile:v",
   517	                    _encoder_profile(
   518	                        target_profile.video_codec,
   519	                        target_profile.video_profile,
   520	                    ),
   521	                ]
   522	            )
   523	        if target_profile.video_level is not None:
   524	            argv.extend(
   525	                [
   526	                    "-level:v",
   527	                    _level(
   528	                        target_profile.video_level,
   529	                        codec=target_profile.video_codec,
   530	                    )
   531	                    or target_profile.video_level,
   532	                ]
   533	            )
   534	        argv.extend(["-pix_fmt", target_profile.pixel_format])
   535	    else:
   536	        argv.extend(["-c:v", "copy"])
   537	
   538	    if target_profile.has_audio:
   539	        assert target_profile.audio_codec is not None
   540	        assert target_profile.audio_sample_rate is not None
   541	        assert target_profile.audio_channel_layout is not None
   542	        argv.extend(["-map", "0:a:0"])
   543	        if audio_transcode:
   544	            audio_filter = (
   545	                "asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,"
   546	                f"aformat=sample_rates={target_profile.audio_sample_rate}:"
   547	                f"channel_layouts={target_profile.audio_channel_layout}"
   548	            )
   549	            argv.extend(
   550	                [
   551	                    "-af",
   552	                    audio_filter,
   553	                    "-c:a",
   554	                    _audio_encoder(target_profile.audio_codec),
   555	                ]
   556	            )
   557	        else:
   558	            argv.extend(["-c:a", "copy"])
   559	    else:
   560	        argv.append("-an")
   561	
   562	    argv.extend(
   563	        [
   564	            "-video_track_timescale",
   565	            str(_mp4_timescale(target_profile)),
   566	        ]
   567	    )
   568	    if faststart:
   569	        argv.extend(["-movflags", "+faststart"])
   570	    argv.extend(["-f", "mp4", str(output_path)])
   571	    return argv
   572	
   573	
   574	def build_concat_command(
   575	    list_path: Path,
   576	    output_path: Path,
   577	    *,
   578	    target_profile: RenderProfile,
   579	    faststart: bool,
   580	) -> list[str]:
   581	    """Build the final concat-demuxer stream-copy command."""
   582	
   583	    argv = [
   584	        "ffmpeg",
   585	        "-hide_banner",
   586	        "-y",
   587	        "-f",
   588	        "concat",
   589	        "-safe",
   590	        "0",
   591	        "-i",
   592	        str(list_path),
   593	        "-map",
   594	        "0:v:0",
   595	    ]
   596	    if target_profile.has_audio:
   597	        argv.extend(["-map", "0:a:0"])
   598	    else:
   599	        argv.append("-an")
   600	    argv.extend(
   601	        [
   602	            "-c",
   603	            "copy",
   604	            "-video_track_timescale",
   605	            str(_mp4_timescale(target_profile)),
   606	        ]
   607	    )
   608	    if faststart:
   609	        argv.extend(["-movflags", "+faststart"])
   610	    argv.extend(["-f", "mp4", str(output_path)])
   611	    return argv
   612	
   613	
   614	def _concat_file_line(path: Path) -> str:
   615	    # FFmpeg's concat demuxer uses shell-like single-quote escaping even though
   616	    # the command itself is never run through a shell.
   617	    resolved = str(path.resolve())
   618	    if "\n" in resolved or "\r" in resolved:
   619	        raise ValueError("FFmpeg concat input paths must not contain CR or LF")
   620	    escaped = resolved.replace("'", "'\\''")
   621	    return f"file '{escaped}'"
   622	
   623	
   624	def _run_checked(runner: Runner, argv: list[str]) -> None:
   625	    runner(argv, check=True)
   626	
   627	
   628	def _assemble_prepared_segments(
   629	    segments: Sequence[_PreparedSegment],
   630	    output_path: Path,
   631	    *,
   632	    target_profile: RenderProfile,
   633	    faststart: bool,
   634	    runner: Runner,
   635	) -> list[str]:
   636	    """Normalize incompatible segments and atomically assemble the output."""
   637	
   638	    if not segments:
   639	        raise ValueError("at least one segment is required for finalization")
   640	    _validate_target_profile(target_profile)
   641	    output_path = output_path.absolute()
   642	    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   643	    normalization: list[str] = []
   644	
   645	    with TemporaryDirectory(
   646	        prefix=f".{output_path.name}.ffmpeg-finalizer-",
   647	        dir=str(output_path.parent),
   648	    ) as tmp_text:
   649	        tmp_dir = Path(tmp_text)
   650	        concat_paths: list[Path] = []
   651	        for segment in segments:
   652	            differences = _profile_differences(segment.profile, target_profile)
   653	            if not differences:
   654	                concat_paths.append(segment.path)
   655	                continue
   656	            normalization.extend(
   657	                _normalization_record(segment.index, difference)
   658	                for difference in differences
   659	            )
   660	            normalized_path = (
   661	                tmp_dir / "normalized" / f"segment-{segment.index:04d}.mp4"
   662	            )
   663	            normalized_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   664	            command = build_normalize_command(
   665	                segment,
   666	                normalized_path,
   667	                target_profile=target_profile,
   668	                differences=differences,
   669	                faststart=faststart,
   670	            )
   671	            _run_checked(runner, command)
   672	            if not normalized_path.is_file() or normalized_path.stat().st_size <= 0:
   673	                raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   674	                    backend=BACKEND_ID,
   675	                    message=(
   676	                        f"FFmpeg did not produce normalized segment[{segment.index}]"
   677	                    ),
   678	                    recovery_command="rerun finalization in a fresh invocation workspace",
   679	                    details={"segment_index": segment.index},
   680	                )
   681	            concat_paths.append(normalized_path)
   682	
   683	        list_path = tmp_dir / "segments.ffconcat"
   684	        list_path.write_text(
   685	            "ffconcat version 1.0\n"
   686	            + "\n".join(_concat_file_line(path) for path in concat_paths)
   687	            + "\n",
   688	            encoding="utf-8",
   689	        )
   690	        staged_output = tmp_dir / "final" / output_path.name
   691	        staged_output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   692	        _run_checked(
   693	            runner,
   694	            build_concat_command(
   695	                list_path,
   696	                staged_output,
   697	                target_profile=target_profile,
   698	                faststart=faststart,
   699	            ),
   700	        )
   701	        if not staged_output.is_file() or staged_output.stat().st_size <= 0:
   702	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   703	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
   704	                message="FFmpeg did not produce a finalized video",
   705	                recovery_command="rerun finalization in a fresh invocation workspace",
   706	                details={"output": output_path.name},
   707	            )
   708	        os.replace(staged_output, output_path)
   709	    return normalization
   710	
   711	
   712	def _duration_fraction(probe: MediaProbe) -> Fraction:
   713	    if probe.duration_rational is not None:
   714	        try:
   715	            duration = Fraction(*probe.duration_rational)
   716	        except (TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError) as exc:
   717	            raise MediaProbeError("ffprobe returned an invalid rational duration") from exc
   718	    elif probe.duration_seconds is not None:
   719	        try:
   720	            duration = Fraction(str(probe.duration_seconds))
   720	            duration = Fraction(str(probe.duration_seconds))
   721	        except (ValueError, ZeroDivisionError) as exc:
   722	            raise MediaProbeError("ffprobe returned an invalid duration") from exc
   723	    else:
   724	        raise MediaProbeError("ffprobe did not report media duration")
   725	    if duration <= 0:
   726	        raise MediaProbeError("ffprobe reported a non-positive media duration")
   727	    return duration
   728	
   729	
   730	def _required_probe_value(value: Any, label: str) -> Any:
   731	    if value is None:
   732	        raise MediaProbeError(f"ffprobe did not report {label}")
   733	    return value
   734	
   735	
   736	def _layout_from_probe(probe: MediaProbe) -> str | None:
   737	    if probe.audio_channel_layout is not None:
   738	        return probe.audio_channel_layout
   739	    return {
   740	        1: "mono",
   741	        2: "stereo",
   742	        6: "5.1",
   743	        8: "7.1",
   744	    }.get(probe.audio_channels)
   745	
   746	
   747	def _profile_from_probe(
   748	    probe: MediaProbe,
   749	    *,
   750	    ownership: AudioOwnership,
   751	    duration_tolerance: int,
   752	) -> RenderProfile:
   753	    if not probe.has_video_stream:
   754	        raise MediaProbeError("media has no video stream")
   755	    if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED and not probe.has_audio_stream:
   756	        raise MediaProbeError("media has no required audio stream")
   757	    if ownership is not AudioOwnership.RENDERED and probe.has_audio_stream:
   758	        raise MediaProbeError(
   759	            f"visual-only {ownership.value} media unexpectedly contains audio"
   760	        )
   761	    return RenderProfile(
   762	        width=_required_probe_value(probe.width, "video width"),
   763	        height=_required_probe_value(probe.height, "video height"),
   764	        fps_rational=_required_probe_value(probe.fps_rational, "video frame rate"),
   765	        time_base=_required_probe_value(probe.time_base, "video time base"),
   766	        container=_required_probe_value(probe.container, "container"),
   767	        video_codec=_required_probe_value(probe.video_codec, "video codec"),
   768	        video_profile=probe.video_profile,
   769	        video_level=probe.video_level,
   770	        pixel_format=_required_probe_value(probe.pixel_format, "pixel format"),
   771	        audio_codec=(
   772	            _required_probe_value(probe.audio_codec, "audio codec")
   773	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   774	            else None
   775	        ),
   776	        audio_sample_rate=(
   777	            _required_probe_value(probe.audio_sample_rate, "audio sample rate")
   778	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   779	            else None
   780	        ),
   781	        audio_channel_layout=(
   782	            _required_probe_value(_layout_from_probe(probe), "audio channel layout")
   783	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   784	            else None
   785	        ),
   786	        duration_tolerance=duration_tolerance,
   787	    )
   788	
   789	
   790	def _duration_frames_from_probe(probe: MediaProbe, profile: RenderProfile) -> int:
   791	    frames = _duration_fraction(probe) * Fraction(*profile.fps_rational)
   792	    return max(1, int(frames + Fraction(1, 2)))
   793	
   794	
   795	def concat_segment_files(
   796	    segment_paths: Sequence[Path],
   797	    output_path: Path,
   798	    *,
   799	    profile: RenderProfile | None = None,
   800	    audio: AudioOwnership | str | None = None,
   801	    faststart: bool = True,
   802	    runner: Runner | None = None,
   803	    probe: Probe | None = None,
   804	) -> list[str]:
   805	    """Strictly probe and assemble explicit files for the legacy facade.
   806	
   807	    Protocol callers use :func:`finalize`; this helper exists so hybrid
   808	    rendering can keep its historical two-argument concat seam while sharing
   809	    the finalizer's normalization implementation.
   810	    """
   811	
   812	    execute = subprocess.run if runner is None else runner
   813	    inspect = ffprobe_metadata_strict if probe is None else probe
   814	    paths = [Path(path).resolve() for path in segment_paths]
   815	    if not paths:
   816	        raise ValueError("at least one segment is required for finalization")
   817	    probes = [inspect(path) for path in paths]
   818	
   819	    if audio is None:
   820	        ownership = (
   821	            AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   822	            if (profile is not None and profile.has_audio)
   823	            or (profile is None and probes[0].has_audio_stream)
   824	            else AudioOwnership.NONE
   825	        )
   826	    else:
   827	        ownership = audio if isinstance(audio, AudioOwnership) else AudioOwnership(audio)
   828	
   829	    if profile is None:
   830	        first_profile = _profile_from_probe(
   831	            probes[0],
   832	            ownership=ownership,
   833	            duration_tolerance=1,
   834	        )
   835	        target_profile = (
   836	            first_profile
   837	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   838	            else _profile_without_audio(first_profile)
   839	        )
   840	    else:
   841	        target_profile = (
   842	            profile
   843	            if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   844	            else _profile_without_audio(profile)
   845	        )
   846	
   847	    prepared: list[_PreparedSegment] = []
   848	    for index, (path, media_probe) in enumerate(zip(paths, probes, strict=True)):
   849	        source_ownership = (
   850	            AudioOwnership.RENDERED
   851	            if media_probe.has_audio_stream
   852	            else (
   853	                AudioOwnership.PASSTHROUGH
   854	                if ownership is AudioOwnership.PASSTHROUGH
   855	                else AudioOwnership.NONE
   856	            )
   857	        )
   858	        source_profile = _profile_from_probe(
   859	            media_probe,
   860	            ownership=source_ownership,
   861	            duration_tolerance=target_profile.duration_tolerance,
   862	        )
   863	        if ownership is AudioOwnership.RENDERED and source_ownership is not AudioOwnership.RENDERED:
   864	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   865	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
   866	                message=f"segment[{index}] is missing audio required by rendered mode",
   867	                recovery_command="render every segment with canonical audio and retry",
   868	                details={"segment_index": index, "audio_ownership": ownership.value},
   869	            )
   870	        prepared.append(
   871	            _PreparedSegment(
   872	                index=index,
   873	                path=path,
   874	                profile=source_profile,
   875	                audio=source_ownership,
   876	                duration_frames=_duration_frames_from_probe(media_probe, source_profile),
   877	            )
   878	        )
   879	
   880	    assembly_profile = _assembly_profile(target_profile, prepared)
   881	    published = False
   882	    try:
   883	        normalization = _assemble_prepared_segments(
   884	            prepared,
   885	            Path(output_path),
   886	            target_profile=assembly_profile,
   887	            faststart=faststart,
   888	            runner=execute,
   889	        )
   890	        published = True
   891	        final_probe = inspect(Path(output_path))
   892	        final_profile = _profile_from_probe(
   893	            final_probe,
   894	            ownership=ownership,
   895	            duration_tolerance=assembly_profile.duration_tolerance,
   896	        )
   897	        remaining = _profile_differences(final_profile, assembly_profile)
   898	        if remaining:
   899	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   900	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
   901	                message="finalized video does not match the requested canonical profile",
   902	                recovery_command="rerun finalization in a fresh invocation workspace",
   903	                details={
   904	                    "mismatches": [
   905	                        _normalization_record(-1, difference)
   906	                        for difference in remaining
   907	                    ]
   908	                },
   909	            )
   910	        return normalization
   911	    except BaseException:
   912	        if published:
   913	            Path(output_path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
   914	        raise
   915	
   916	
   917	# Historical private name retained for direct callers while the facade moves.
   918	_concat_segments = concat_segment_files
   919	
   920	
   921	def _config(mapping: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
   922	    config = dict(mapping.get(BACKEND_ID, {}))
   923	    reasons: list[str] = []
   924	    unknown = sorted(set(config) - _CONFIG_KEYS)
   925	    if unknown:
   926	        reasons.append(f"unknown {BACKEND_ID} configuration: {', '.join(unknown)}")
   927	    faststart = config.get("faststart", True)
   928	    if not isinstance(faststart, bool):
   929	        reasons.append("faststart must be a boolean")
   930	        faststart = True
   931	    return faststart, reasons
   932	
   933	
   934	def support(request: RenderRequest, *, workspace: Path) -> SupportReport:
   935	    """Return request-sensitive support evidence for canonical finalization."""
   936	
   937	    del workspace  # Support is profile/config sensitive; it does not read inputs.
   938	    _faststart, reasons = _config(request.backend_config)
   939	    if request.profile is not None:
   940	        try:
   941	            _validate_target_profile(request.profile)
   942	        except RendererException as exc:
   943	            reasons.append(exc.error.message)
   944	        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   945	            reasons.append(str(exc))
   946	    for binary in ("ffmpeg", "ffprobe"):
   947	        if shutil.which(binary) is None:
   948	            reasons.append(f"required binary is unavailable: {binary}")
   949	    requested_audio = request.audio.value if request.audio is not None else "request-dependent"
   950	    return SupportReport(
   951	        schema_version=SCHEMA_VERSION,
   952	        supported=not reasons,
   953	        reasons=reasons,
   954	        features={
   955	            "strict_probe": True,
   956	            "stream_copy": True,
   957	            "profile_normalization": True,
   958	            "preserves_attachments": True,
   959	            "audio_ownership": requested_audio,
   960	        },
   961	        alternatives=[],
   962	        backend=BACKEND_ID,
   963	        backend_version=BACKEND_VERSION,
   964	    )
   965	
   966	
   967	def _final_audio_ownership(request: FinalizeRequest) -> AudioOwnership:
   968	    ownerships = [artifact.audio for artifact in request.artifacts]
   969	    for index, ownership in enumerate(ownerships):
   970	        if ownership is None:
   971	            raise_invalid_artifact_error(
   972	                backend=BACKEND_ID,
   973	                message=f"segment[{index}] does not declare audio ownership",
   974	                recovery_command="rerender the segment with explicit audio ownership",
   975	                details={"segment_index": index},
